title: AI Ad Script Generation Job For E-commerce Brand (Full-time)
description:
Job Overview

We’re looking to hire a full-time Junior Creative Strategist to simply copy winning ad scripts in our niche using AI tools and our own training. You’ll be doing daily research on brands in our niche and copying their ads using simple AI prompts you come up with. 



About Us

We’re an e-commerce holding company primarily in health and beauty, selling supplements. Unlike other job listings, you’ll be working with us for a long time most likely, since we run actual longterm health brands and not dropship products like others.



Your Core Responsibilities

- Daily research of other brands on the ads library and angle ideas

- Produce a consistent 5-10+ scripts per work day (using AI, I will provide SOPs showing how I get 40 done per day). 

- Doing weekly learnings on our winning ads and understanding why they did well (hooks, avatars, angles)

- Studying courses & programs on creative strategy & copywriting that I give you

- Understanding the customers' pain points better than they do, this can be done through research on Reddit, Quora, TikTok, Grok, and more. You’ll be using these to come up with new angles and develop your research papers on our product(s) even more.



What to Expect

- A simple, not easy job. All the heavy lifting will be provided to you in the training SOP, including where and how to conduct research. The only thing you’ll need to do yourself is generate prompts.

- Flexible working hours, we may send you an ad at 5 am. I’d expect you to work on it whenever you’re available

- Focus on quality scripts and not quantity. A quality script has an intent behind it, with engaging hooks that spark curiosity. AI will often repeat a lot of the same hooks and styles, so you’ll have to use a platform like Grok or your own writing to fix it.



What you need

- Good internet speed

- AI tools like Claude, Grok, and Gemini (will all be paid and provided to you in the future)

- Good English understanding 

- Follow social media trending concepts, for example, animated cartoon ads

- IMPORTANT: Time! This isn’t a side hustle or a free ride. The job is very simple and has potential for high pay, but we only want people who will be working with us, and nobody else.



How to get the job?

1. Send us your resume/experience, including your English reading/understanding level (from 1 - 10, with 10 being perfect).

2. We’ll send you our brand & product details 

3. We’ll then give you an example of a winning ad from another brand and ask you to create a new one for our brand + angle using your own prompt

4. We’ll review it, and if it’s good, we’ll hire you right away.

title: Web & Design Support Specialist
description:
Web & Design Support Specialist

Remote · Part-Time (with Full-Time Potential) · Eastern Time



About Us

We are a web design and SEO studio based in New Jersey, and we've been at it for seven years. We build and care for websites for creative and service-based business owners, photographers, interior designers, coaches, and the like, who want an online home that feels as considered as the work they do offline. Our philosophy comes down to one idea: your website should let you show up online the way you show up in real life.



About the Role

As our Web & Design Support Specialist, you'll be the steady hand keeping our clients' websites current and looking their best, while also acting as the central point of communication across our projects. The work is a blend of hands-on website updates, design, social media, and light coordination, all built around care and attention to detail. This is a long-term role for someone who takes pride in their work and wants to grow alongside a studio that values them.



What You'll Do

???? Keep client websites current. Add and update content across our clients' sites, including new webinars, events, tea
mbers, articles, photos, and copy.



???? Run point on client tickets. Manage incoming requests in our CRM and act as the main point of contact so clients always know their work is in good hands.



???? Be the hub of communication. Coordinate with the rest of our team and outside collaborators (developers, senior designers, contractors) to keep every project moving smoothly.



???? Create graphics and social content. Design graphics in Canva when a ticket calls for it, and produce social graphics, reels, and light video edits for the studio's Instagram and Pinterest.



???? Show off the work. Put together before-and-afters of our projects, plus the occasional launch graphics we gift to clients when their sites go live.



???? Keep us consistent on social. Maintain a posting schedule for Instagram and Pinterest so our work stays visible.



???? Handle basic on-page SEO. Add meta descriptions, alt text, and other small optimizations as part of the edits.





Who You Are

???? You're confident working in Showit, WordPress, and Squarespace.



???? You're detail-oriented to your core, the kind of person who catches what most people miss.



???? You communicate clearly and warmly in both written and verbal English, and you're comfortable being the point of contact for clients and collaborators.



???? You manage your time well and keep things moving without needing to be chased.



???? You're available during Eastern time hours so our days line up.



???? You're looking for a long-term partnership over short-term work. I'd rather invest in one person and keep them for years.

Even Better If



???? You have experience with
 marketing in Flodesk or similar platforms (mailchimp, convertkit, GHL, kajabi)



???? You have a basic foundation in SEO beyond the on-page essentials.



???? You've built a portfolio of aesthetic, well-designed graphics for social media.



How We Work Together

Most of our team has been with the studio for three years or more, and that's exactly what we're hoping for with this hire. We're not trying to build a big agency. We like being small, taking on work we genuinely care about, and protecting a happy, balanced life for everyone on the team. Most of the work runs on your own schedule, with the two of us meeting every two weeks to talk through questions, active projects, and anything that needs a decision. We don't do many client calls, though you may occasionally sit in on one to take notes.



Support and Training

You won't be thrown in and left to figure things out on your own. I provide hands-on training from the start and will walk you through many of our projects personally. For the things that are easier to show than to explain, I record Looms you can rewatch as often as you need. And when something feels hard, you'll have experienced tea
mbers to lean on. The goal is for you to feel supported, not stranded.



Schedule and Hours

This is a set Monday through Friday schedule, which keeps things consistent for everyone (you included) when it comes to hours, pay, and rhythm. The ideal working window falls somewhere between 10 AM and 5 PM Eastern, Monday through Friday, with major holidays off. To confirm you've read this far, please include a picture of a pink bunny somewhere in your application. The role runs 20 to 25 hours a week to start, and I'm open to a full-time 30 hours depending on your experience and availability.



COMPENSATION$ $5/hr-$8/hr depending on experience.



***** How to Apply

If this sounds like the kind of work and team you've been looking for, I'd love to hear from you. Send a short note about your experience with Showit, WordPress, and/or Squarespace, a few examples of website edits or graphics you've created, any similar work you've done and a little about yourself. 



I read every application personally.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to organize and run a department from the ground up.



What You’ll Do:

Establish and maintain company-wide Revit sheet templates, standard details, title blocks, and BIM protocols

Lead structural detailing for wood, steel, and concrete buildings

Serve as the primary point of contact for all CAD coordination between the Philippine team and US-based ownership

Review and QA drawings to ensure consistency with our developing standards

Mentor and coordinate with our current CAD technician as the department grows

Collaborate with our in-house software engineer to identify workflow bottlenecks and test Python-based automation scripts tailored to our projects



What You’ll Need:

5+ years of professional experience in Revit, preferably within structural engineering

Proven experience detailing wood, steel, and concrete structures

Demonstrated ability to set up sheet templates, view standards, and company detail libraries from scratch

Strong working knowledge of the Imperial measurement system (feet and inches) as used in US construction

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with comfort coordinating across time zones with an American owner.

Must be available for daily all-employee meetings during US work hours.

Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote-work environment



Nice to Have:

Prior team lead, senior drafter, or department head experience

Familiarity with Dynamo, Revit API, or Python-based BIM automation

Knowledge of US structural drawing standards and typical US construction practices



What We Offer:

title: Service Desk Coordinator
description:
SERVICE DESK COORDINATOR

User Support Function - Ticket Triage - Service Coordination

Net Value Partners - Your Technology Partner in Value Creation



============================================================



ABOUT NET VALUE PARTNERS



Net Value Partners (NetVP) is a technology department - an entire technology organization that operates as part of a client's business, not a vendor beside it. Built with an executive strategy layer at the top and six specialized functions beneath it - Cybersecurity, Network Operations, User Support, Project Delivery, Technology Supply Chain, and Business Intelligence & AI - we cover every layer of technology a growing business depends on, and we stay accountable for the outcomes, not just the activity. Our mission is to turn technology into 
ntum for the businesses we serve.



What makes us different is depth. We don't do a little for many - we do a lot for a few. We deliberately partner with a small number of growing, multi-location businesses in operations-critical industries and go deep into their environments, their processes, and their goals. That focus is the whole point: it lets our people truly know the systems and the people they support, rather than spreading thin across hundreds of accounts they'll never understand.



That model only works with the right people, so this is how we build our team. We hire for the long term and invest in people who want to grow with us. Because we go deep for a few clients, the coordinators and engineers here become genuine experts in the environments they own - trusted, recognized, and given real responsibility rather than a queue of strangers' tickets. When our name is on the work, we own it, and every function is named, measured, and accountable. We expect a lot, we support each other, and we operate as one coordinated department rather than a collection of individual roles.



We're headquartered in Naples, Florida, and remote-first, embedded in our clients' workflows wherever they operate. We hold ourselves to a clear set of standards in how we work: excellence as a baseline, continuous improvement, customer-centric decisions, integrity in every action, and strategic, long-term thinking. If you're looking for a place to go deep, build mastery, and stay for the long haul - not bounce between tickets for clients you'll never really know - you'll fit here.



ROLE OVERVIEW



As our Service Desk Coordinator, you are the first voice and first impression our clients meet. You own the front door of our User Support function - answering calls and
s, capturing every request accurately, triaging and routing work to the right function, and keeping tickets moving so nothing stalls or slips. This is a people-first role for someone who is genuinely easy to talk to: warm, calm, and clear with users of every technical level, while staying organized and disciplined behind the scenes. When a request comes through you, you own getting it to the right place.



Because we go deep for a small number of clients, you won't be a faceless voice on a high-churn queue. You'll get to know the people you support by name, learn how their business actually runs, and become the dependable front door they trust over time. This is a long-term seat for someone who wants to build that kind of relationship.



This is a fully remote, work-from-home position reporting to the Support Manager.



EMPLOYMENT DETAILS



- Work Setup: Fully Remote (Work From Home)

- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST (10-hour shift with 1-hour unpaid lunch)

- Compensation: Based on experience

- Reports To: Support Manager

- Trial Period: 90 days



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



Client Communication & Call Handling:



- Serve as the first point of contact for clients across phone,
, and the ticketing portal.

- Answer inbound calls promptly and professionally, making every client feel heard and informed.

- Communicate clearly and patiently with users of all technical levels, translating between plain language and technical detail.

- Provide proactive, same-business-day updates so clients are never left wondering about the status of their request.



Ticket Triage & Routing:



- Log every request into ConnectWise PSA with complete, accurate, well-written detail.

- As the single cross-functional coordination point, triage and route every ticket to the right destination by subject domain and criticality - User Support for daily IT issues, Network Operations for infrastructure and network, Cybersecurity for security events, and Project Delivery for migrations, deployments, and major changes.

- Recognize the domain of an incoming issue quickly - a user problem, an infrastructure problem, a security signal, or project-level work - and direct it accordingly without bouncing the client between functions.

- Apply sound ticket prioritization and adhere strictly to SLA commitments, fast-tracking high-criticality and security-related tickets.

- Acknowledge new tickets within 15 minutes and ensure no ticket sits unassigned or goes stale.



Engineer Support & Follow-Ups:



- Act as a coordination point for engineers - assisting with ticket creation, scheduling, and follow-ups so they can stay focused on resolution.

- Ensure engineers have all necessary information and context before work begins.

- Perform proactive follow-ups with both clients and tea
mbers to keep tickets progressing and eliminate stale work.

- Serve as the communication bridge during ongoing issues and active escalations.



Escalation & Judgment:



- Escalate to any function - User Support, Network Operations, Cybersecurity, or Project Delivery - when scope, subject domain, or criticality calls for it, including project-level planning or leadership input.

- Treat suspected security issues as high-priority: route them to the Cybersecurity function promptly rather than holding them in the general queue.

- Escalate promptly when an SLA deadline is at risk.

- Flag incomplete tickets and gather missing details before assignment.

- Recognize when a ticket needs reassignment to a different function or urgent technical attention, and act on it.



Documentation & Ticket Hygiene:



- Maintain accurate ticket statuses throughout the lifecycle: New, In Progress, Waiting, Resolved.

- Record clear notes and a complete communication history in ConnectWise PSA.

- Close tickets only after confirming resolution with the client.

- Build and maintain the Service Desk Coordinator Playbook - triage processes, escalation paths, call scripts, and operating procedures.

- Submit timesheets accurately and on time each work period.



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS



- Ticket acknowledgment speed (target: within 15 minutes).

- Routing accuracy and low reassignment rate.

- Call pick-up rate and responsiveness.

- Absence of stale or unassigned tickets.

- Client satisfaction and feedback scores.

- Timesheet accuracy and timeliness.



QUALIFICATIONS



Required:



- Excellent written and spoken English, with a warm, professional phone presence.

- Strong customer service instincts - a person people find genuinely easy to talk to.

- Hands-on experience with ConnectWise PSA, or a comparable PSA/ticketing platform.

- Solid ticket prioritization skills and a working understanding of SLA management.

- Basic to intermediate understanding of common IT issues 
, MFA, permissions, connectivity).

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and comfort handling high call volume.



Preferred:



- Experience in an MSP, NOC, or IT service environment.

- Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and its common user-facing issues.

- Prior experience building or contributing to team playbooks or runbooks.



IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal Service Desk Coordinator is approachable, organized, and calm under pressure. They take ownership of the client experience from the first hello, keep work flowing across the team without being told to, and treat clear communication and clean documentation as core to the job - not an afterthought.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your resume and application to: 

Subject line: Hire Me - Service Desk Coordinator



To be considered, please answer these three questions in your application:



1. This role works US business hours (8:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST, Monday to Friday). Are you able to commit to this schedule long-term, and what is your current home internet and backup setup for remote work?



2. A client calls in frustrated about an urgent issue, and while you're on that call two more tickets come in by
. Walk us through how you would handle the next 15 minutes.



3. Tell us about your experience with ticketing/PSA systems (ConnectWise or similar) and how differentiate between a service ticket and a project ticket? 



All new employees complete a 90-day trial and training period before transitioning to regular employment status.

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us.



I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company.



If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply:



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar &
 Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to
 & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



-- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and
 service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.



If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply.



PERKS:

I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including
 and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation



After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include:

- Part time work hours

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

- Starting Salary at $500 USD a month ($6000 USD annual)

- Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn)



Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

title: YouTube Research Assistant - Tesla, SpaceX & Elon Musk Niche
description:
I am looking for a part-time YouTube Research Assistant for a YouTube channel focused on Tesla, SpaceX, and Elon Musk.



This is NOT a generic writing job:

I am looking for someone who is genuinely and deeply interested and passionate about everything related to Tesla, SpaceX, Elon Musk, and also the businesses/ventures connected to him.



This part is very important: if you are not truly interested in these topics, this role is not a good fit for you.



I am personally deeply passionate about these topics, and I am looking ONLY for someone who also has a real and genuine passion and interest about these topics.



Your main job will be to help with Tesla / SpaceX research, video ideation, and topic development before videos are written.



This means you will not only collect information, but also think about how that information could become a strong YouTube video: what the main angle could be, why viewers would care, what the strongest thesis is, and what sources support the idea.



Tasks may include:



• Finding strong Tesla / SpaceX / Elon Musk sources for future YouTube videos

• Spotting possible video ideas from news, interviews, earnings calls, X.com posts, company updates, and market narratives

• Turning raw research into possible YouTube angles or theses

• Explaining why a topic could be interesting to viewers

• Identifying the strongest bull case and bear case for a topic

• Reading and summarizing earnings calls, investor updates, official company posts, interviews, articles, and reports

• Finding useful quotes, timestamps, clips, charts, or screenshots

• Separating confirmed facts from estimates, opinions, rumors, and speculation

• Creating clear research briefs that are already oriented toward a YouTube video

• Suggesting possible video structures, hooks, and key arguments

• Fact-checking scripts or claims before publishing

• Helping organize research in Google Docs / Notion / Google Drive



At first, the role will mainly focus on research, ideation, fact-checking, and topic development.



However, my goal is not to find someone only for a short-term task. My goal is to find the right person to work with long-term, ideally for the years to come.



If the collaboration works well, the role could expand over time into helping with outlines, script structure, script drafts, and other parts of the YouTube production process.



The role is starting as part-time, but it could grow into more hours or even a full-time role in the future if there is a strong fit on both sides.



Also, as the collaboration grows and the person becomes more valuable to the channel, the hourly rate can increase over time based on performance and value.



The most important things I am looking for are:



1. Genuine interest in Tesla / SpaceX / Elon Musk

2. Strong English reading and writing

3. Good research ability

4. Ability to think critically, not just copy/paste information

5. Ability to think in terms of YouTube videos, not just general research

6. Strong curiosity and willingness to learn

7. Proactive mindset: someone who can bring ideas, not only wait for instructions

8. Attention to detail

9. Reliability and clear communication

10. Long-term mindset and desire to grow with the channel



Please do not apply if you are not genuinely interested in Tesla, SpaceX, Elon Musk, or these types of topics.



Generic applications, copy/paste answers, or AI-generated answers without real understanding will not be considered. For the strongest candidates, I will also do a short video call to discuss Tesla, SpaceX, Elon Musk, and the role in more detail. This is mainly to understand if there is a real fit for a long-term collaboration.



To apply, please answer these questions in your own words:



Please be specific. Generic answers, copy/paste answers, or AI-style answers will not be considered.



1. When did you first become interested in Tesla, SpaceX, or Elon Musk? What specifically triggered your interest?

2. How do you follow these topics in your daily or weekly routine?

3. What was the last Tesla, SpaceX, or Elon Musk-related topic that genuinely interested you and why?

4. Which Tesla product or business do you think most people misunderstand right now? Please explain your reasoning.

5. What is one Tesla-related topic or SpaceX-related topic that you think could become a strong YouTube video right now? What would the main angle be?

6. Name 10 specific sources you use or would use to research Tesla / SpaceX / Elon Musk topics. These can include social media channels, X.com profiles or other sources.

7. Pick one recent Tesla, SpaceX, or Elon Musk-related news item and explain how you would research it for a YouTube video. What sources would you check? What questions would you try to answer?

8. Are you comfortable using Google Docs, Google Drive, and Notion?

9. How many hours per week are you available?

10. What is your hourly rate?

11. Are you only looking for part-time work, or would you be open to increasing your hours in the future if the collaboration works well? If yes, how many hours per week could you realistically work later?



There may be a small paid research test for selected candidates before starting regular work.



If you are genuinely passionate about Tesla, SpaceX, Elon Musk, and future technology, this could be a very interesting and rewarding role because you would spend your time researching, thinking about, and developing content around these topics.



But if these topics do not naturally interest you, this role will probably feel boring very quickly, so please only apply if the interest is real.

title: Inbound Sales and Scheduling Coordinator (US Pacific Hours)
description:
We are a growing junk removal company in the Pacific Northwest looking for a sharp, all-around front-of-house person. You will be the first point of contact across every way a customer reaches us: phone calls,
 leads, website form leads, and text. We need someone who can hold a conversation, handle pushback, and turn an interested lead into a booked job no matter where it came from. This is a full-time, long-term role working US Pacific business hours (8am to 5pm Pacific, which is roughly 11pm to 8am Philippine time). You must be comfortable and consistent on this schedule.



What you will do:

- Answer inbound calls live and respond to texts quickly

- Work
 lead form submissions and website Google form leads fast, while they are still warm, following up by call and message

- Qualify each lead: name, phone, city, items, load size, preferred date

- Handle common objections with confidence and keep the conversation moving toward a booking. Examples you will hear daily: that is more than I expected, I need to think about it, can you do better on price, I want to call around first, why do you need to come look before quoting

- Book jobs and estimates in our scheduling software and keep the calendar organized across four service areas

- Follow our pricing sheet exactly and quote firm single-item prices only, never a range

- Run B2B outreach to local realtors and contractors using our
 and text sequences (this part may grow over time)

- Keep clear, accurate notes in every customer record

- Escalate anything you cannot resolve to our operations manager with a clean handoff



What we are looking for:

- Excellent spoken and written English, clear and warm on the phone and in writing

- Proven ability to handle objections without being pushy. We want someone who listens, addresses the real concern, and asks for the booking

- Comfortable juggling multiple lead sources at once without letting any go cold

- Experience with Housecall Pro and GoHighLevel is a strong plus (tell us in your application if you have used either)

- Background in appointment setting, inbound sales, dispatch, scheduling, or lead follow-up

- Any B2B or cold outreach experience is a plus

- Dependable working full time during US Pacific business hours (8am to 5pm Pacific), strong internet, quiet call environment, working headset.

- Extremely detail-oriented and calm under pressure



This role lives or dies on attention to detail, so we have built that into how you apply. Please read every step carefully before you reply.



To apply, reply with:

1. Begin your message with the word ANCHOR in all caps as the very first word. This tells us you read the full post.

2. A short note on your experience with phone-based scheduling or sales, and any experience working leads from
 or web forms

3. Whether you have used Housecall Pro or GoHighLevel

4. Tell us which shift you are confirming you can work, written out in both Pacific time and your local Philippine time, so we know you understand the hours

5. A short answer to this scenario: a customer calls, sounds interested, but says they need to check with their spouse before booking. In two or three sentences, how do you respond?

6. A one to two minute voice recording introducing yourself. In the same recording, pretend a customer just said your price is higher than another company I called. Walk us through how you would respond.



A note on quality: we read every word of your application. Please proofread it. Replies with spelling or grammar mistakes, or replies that ignore any of the steps above, will not be considered, no matter how strong the rest looks. We are not trying to be harsh. The job is detail work, and your application is your first sample of it.



We value people who want to grow with us. This is a stable, long-term position with a team that treats its people well.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
ABOUT SENIORVERSE

Seniorverse is a dynamic startup dedicated to transforming the senior care industry by providing innovative software and operational solutions tailored for adult daycare operators. Our mission is to responsibly serve seniors, their families, and the public good by empowering adult daycare providers with cutting-edge technology to deliver cost-effective, high-quality, and accessible senior care.



JOB DESCRIPTION

We are seeking a Technical Product Manager to bring organization, clarity, and 
ntum to how we build the Seniorverse platform. You will own our product development process end to end: managing our Notion-based ticketing system, maintaining the feature roadmap, and triaging bugs and customer requests so the engineering team always knows what to build next and why.



This is a hands-on, technical, and AI-forward role. You won’t just write specs. You’ll dig into the platform’s data model and APIs, use AI tools to rapidly build working prototypes, put them in front of customers, gather tangible feedback, and refine requirements before anything reaches engineering. You’ll sit at the intersection of our engineering team, implementation team, and customers, translating between all three with equal fluency. The ideal candidate is genuinely technical: comfortable reading code and API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and engaging engineers in detailed discussions about feasibility, trade-offs, and implementation approach. A background in software engineering or hands-on technical work is a strong advantage.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1) Roadmap & Backlog Management

• Own and manage the product ticketing system in Notion, keeping it organized, prioritized, and current

• Plan and maintain the roadmap of future platform features in collaboration with leadership and engineering

• Triage incoming bugs, customer requests, and small enhancements; balance short-term fixes against long-term roadmap priorities

• Write clear, technically detailed tickets with well-defined acceptance criteria that engineers can execute without ambiguity



2) AI-Powered Prototyping & Discovery

• Use AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, or similar) to rapidly build clickable prototypes and proof-of-concepts

• Walk customers through prototypes to gather feedback before engineering investment

• Iterate quickly on prototypes based on customer input, then translate validated designs into engineering-ready specifications

• Stay current on AI tooling and continuously bring new techniques into our product development workflow



3) Technical Collaboration with Engineering

• Engage deeply with the engineering team on architecture, data models, integrations, and technical trade-offs

• Understand the platform at a systems level, including how features interact with our backend services, database, and third-party integrations

• Help assess technical feasibility and effort during roadmap planning

• Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release reviews as the voice of the customer and the product



4) Cross-Functional & Customer Communication

• Serve as the primary liaison between engineering, implementation, and customers

• Speak directly with adult day center operators and staff to understand workflows, pain points, and feature requests

• Partner with the implementation team to ensure new features land smoothly with customers and feedback loops back into the roadmap

• Communicate release plans, timelines, and trade-offs clearly to internal teams and customers



QUALIFICATIONS

• 3+ years of experience in technical product management, software engineering, solutions engineering, or a similar role at a software company (B2B SaaS strongly preferred)

• Demonstrated experience using AI tools to build prototypes or accelerate product work. This is a must-have, and we’ll ask you to show examples

• Strong technical fluency: able to read code, work with REST APIs, understand relational and NoSQL data models, and hold credible conversations with engineers about feasibility, architecture, and trade-offs

• Hands-on engineering experience (even from earlier in your career) is a strong plus; familiarity with TypeScript, React, Node.js, or AWS is a bonus given our stack

• Excellent written and spoken English; confident speaking directly with US-based customers on video calls

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail; you enjoy bringing structure to chaos

• Experience managing a ticketing/backlog system (Notion, Jira, Linear, or similar)

• Availability for significant overlap with US Central Time business hours

• Self-starter comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced startup environment

• Experience in healthcare, senior care, or other regulated industries a plus



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

• Competitive salary based on experience and location

• Paid Time Off

• Fully remote role as an independent contractor



HOW TO APPLY:

• Send your application through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line "Technical Product Manager"

• In your message, include:

1) A brief explanation of why this role is a good fit for your skills and experience

2) One specific example of a prototype or proof-of-concept you've built using AI tools (please include a link, screenshot, or short recording if possible, along with which tools you used)

3) Your experience managing a ticketing or backlog system (Notion, Jira, Linear, or similar)

4) A copy of your resume

5) Confirmation that you are available to work *Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time (ET) or Pacific Time (PT)*



We review applications on a rolling basis and will be in touch promptly.



Seniorverse is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

title: On-Call Dispatcher / Operations Coordinator
description:
Untouchable Transport & Logistics Inc. is seeking a reliable, professional, and highly responsive On-Call Dispatcher / Operations Coordinator to serve as the primary communication link between our company, our drivers, and our logistics partners. This is a remote, phone-based position that requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to respond quickly to operational issues throughout the day.



This role is not a traditional hourly position. It is a daily on-call role designed for someone who can remain available during operating hours to assist with driver communication, dispatch support, route monitoring, and issue resolution.



Availability Requirements



* Must be available daily between 10:00 AM Eastern Time and 10:00 PM Eastern Time

* Must be accessible by phone and RingCentral during scheduled availability

* Must be able to respond promptly to calls, messages, and operational issues throughout the day

* After-hours emergencies occurring after 10:00 PM Eastern should be directed to the company owners



Primary Responsibilities



Driver Communication & Monitoring



* Serve as the dedicated dispatcher for Untouchable Transport & Logistics Inc.

* Communicate directly with drivers throughout the day regarding route progress, delays, emergencies, and operational concerns

* Conduct status checks when requested by management, dispatch partners, or logistics coordinators

* Monitor driver performance and route progress

* Contact drivers when delivery activity appears delayed or paused and determine the reason for interruptions

* Gather accurate information and provide timely updates to the appropriate parties



Partner Communication



* Respond to inquiries from dispatch teams and logistics partners regarding driver and route status

* Act as the communication liaison between drivers and our logistics partners

* Provide accurate updates regarding delays, route progress, emergencies, and delivery completion expectations

* Escalate major issues, serious i
, customer complaints, a
, injuries, or operational concerns directly to company ownership



Route Management & Reporting



* Maintain and distribute the daily route roster for all active routes operated by Untouchable Transport & Logistics Inc.

* Update driver assignments and route changes as directed by ownership

* Maintain detailed records of:

    * Emergencies

    * Route delays

    * Driver issues

    * Carryover deliveries

    * Operational i

* Monitor carryover situations and immediately report any route carrying over more than 10% of its assigned deliveries



End-of-Day & Morning Reporting



* Contact drivers during the evening to determine:

    * Remaining deliveries

    * Route completion status

    * Expected completion time

    * Plans for resuming deliveries the following day if applicable

* Provide ownership with comprehensive daily reports including:

    * Driver status

    * Route performance

    * Carryovers

    * Delays

    * Emergencies

    * Outstanding issues

* Provide morning operational reports and midday reports when requested



Emergency Response & Escalation



* Receive and document emergency calls from drivers

* Determine whether issues should be:

    * Resolved internally through Untouchable Transport & Logistics Inc.

    * Reported to logistics partners

    * Escalated directly to company ownership

* Maintain professional communication during high-pressure situations



Example of Daily Responsibilities



If a logistics partner contacts the dispatcher because a driver has not completed a delivery in over one hour, the dispatcher will:



1. Contact the driver immediately.

2. Determine the reason for the delay.

3. Confirm whether the driver intends to resume deliveries.

4. Verify whether the route can still be completed that day.

5. Relay all relevant information back to the requesting dispatch team.

6. Document the i
 and provide updates to company ownership as necessary.



Systems & Communication Tools



* RingCentral will be the primary communication platform.

* Dispatcher will be added as a member of the Untouchable Transport & Logistics Inc. operations team.

* Dispatcher must provide a dedicated phone number that can be shared with company drivers for operational support.



Required Skills



* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills

* Strong organizational abilities

* Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

* Excellent problem-solving skills

* Professional phone etiquette

* Ability to remain calm under pressure

* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable internet and phone service

* Experience in dispatching, logistics, transportation, customer service, or operations preferred



Compensation



This is a daily on-call position, not an hourly role. Compensation will be discussed with qualified candidates based on experience, availability, responsiveness, and ability to manage operational communications effectively.



Reporting Structure



This position reports directly to the Owners of Untouchable Transport & Logistics Inc.



All major i
, emergencies, a
, safety concerns, customer escalations, and operational issues requiring executive decisions must be immediately referred to ownership.



After 10:00 PM Eastern Time, all driver emergencies and urgent operational matters must be directed to the owners, Kia and Anderson

title: Amazon PPC & Brand Manager
description:
Amazon PPC & Brand Manager

Remote | Full-time | Reporting directly to the CEO



 Read this first:



If you're looking for a job where someone hands you a bid management spreadsheet and tells you which keywords to pause, keep scrolling. This isn't it.



We're looking for someone who wants to **own the profitability of an entire Amazon business** (PPC, listings, launches, pricing, the whole thing) and who gets excited when they see a 14 day search term report with $400 of wasted spend, because they know exactly what to do with it.



About us



We're a profitable, growing consumer products brand on Amazon in the kitchen and family category. Our products are real tools, not toys or gimmicks, and they sit in tens of thousands of homes. We're a category leader in our niche.



We're small, fast, and lean. No bloated agency layers. No politics. You'll talk to the CEO directly, every week.



The role in one sentence:



Every SKU in our catalog is as profitable as it can possibly be on Amazon, and that's on you.



What you'll own:



**PPC is the core of this role.** Sponsored Products, Brands, Display, Creator Connections. You pull the search term reports, you make the calls, you scale winners and cut losers. Every SKU has a target ACOS tied to its role in the business (evergreen, seasonal hero, year round with Q4 spike, liquidating) and you know the difference and you manage accordingly.



**Listings and conversion.** CTR, conversion rate, keyword indexing, A+ content, main images. You flag what's underperforming, you brief the designer on exactly what you need, you split test monthly.



**New product launches.** Listing, campaign, Vine, main image brief, all live at go live, nothing missing. You own the launch checklist and nothing slips.



**Daily account health.** Suppressed listings, hijackers, prime badge, indexing, policy flags. You find it before we do.



 What success looks like in your first 90 days:



- You've mapped every active SKU to a PPC objective and cleaned up the campaigns that don't match

- Wasted spend is down, target ACOS is hit on 90%+ of SKUs, and you can tell us exactly why on the ones that aren't

- Q4 listing plans are revamped with seasonal keywords, gifting angles, and holiday imagery, done before October

- The CEO gets a daily pulse message she easily understands what is being done and why.

- You've run at least two split tests and shared the results

- Ran an deep analysis of the top 6 SKUs and identified and implemented growth levers (all assets and ppc)



Who you are:



- **2 to 5+ years doing Amazon PPC on a real catalog** (not one product, not theoretically, not just "I took a course")

- Fluent in Sellerboard, Helium 10, or similar. Can pull a search term report and tell a story with it

- You think in ACOS, TACOS, CVR, CTR, and BSR, and you know when each one matters and when it doesn't

- You've optimized listings end to end: titles, bullets, backend, A+, indexing

- You write in clear, professional English and communicate proactively (non negotiable: daily pulse, weekly snapshots)

- You have opinions and you defend them with data

- You work independently. Nobody will be checking on you. If that terrifies you, this isn't your role. If it excites you, keep reading.



Bonus points:



- Experience with Q4 heavy seasonal brands

- Sponsored Brands video and Brand Store optimization

- Experience with Creator Connections campaigns

- You've launched new ASINs from zero to ranking



What we offer:



- Direct line to the CEO. No middle management, no bureaucracy

- Full autonomy on PPC decisions within the strategy we set together

- A profitable, growing brand with strong margins and room to scale

- Long term role. We're building a team, not hiring and churning

- Competitive compensation based on experience



How to apply:



Please submit an application through our official link here:







Looking forward to learning more about you!



We read every application that follows the instructions. We don't read the ones that don't.

description:
SALES SUPPORT & ORDER COORDINATOR - CUSTOM SPORTS APPAREL

Standard Philippine business hours are welcome.



============================================================



We're not looking for a traditional "salesperson." We need a

detail-oriented Coordinator who can bridge the gap between a customer's

rough idea and a designer's final output, in the world of custom sports

apparel and sublimated garments. This role rewards accuracy, clarity,

and clear thinking - not script-reading.





THE CORE OF THE ROLE



You'll own inbound enquiries from first contact through to the point of

sale: providing quotes, managing design revisions, and keeping every

detail straight until the customer is ready to buy. When enquiry volume

is lower, you'll shift to data collection, competitor research, and

report preparation.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Design translation: Turn vague customer requests into precise,

  unambiguous briefs for our design team.



- Order accuracy: Prepare and double-check complex order forms, catching

  small data errors before they become expensive production mistakes.



- Working within our process: Operate inside our established templates,

  systems, and workflows. Where you spot room for improvement, raise it

  through the right channel rather than changing things on your own.



- Data & research: Maintain clean, well-organised data and produce clear

  reports to support the team.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Exceptional written English: You write with professional clarity and

  grammatical precision, and you understand the nuances of New Zealand

  English. You can step into an
 thread you weren't part of, pick up

  the context and tone quickly, and respond appropriately.



- A thinker, not a script-reader: We encourage our team to use AI tools

  to polish and speed up their work - but the thinking, judgement, and

  voice need to be yours. This isn't a role for someone who leans on AI

  or templates to do the thinking for them.



- Obsessive attention to detail: You check your own work and the work of

  others. Accuracy is non-negotiable.



- Process discipline and organisation: You follow established processes

  consistently and reliably, and you stay on top of many moving parts

  without dropping threads.



- Strong spreadsheet skills: You're confident managing data and building

  tidy, well-structured reports. We don't rely on complex formulas - but

  our whole business runs on keeping data accurate and orderly, so this

  genuinely matters.



- A significant advantage: Experience selling custom sports apparel and

  sublimated garments, and a working understanding of the

  design-to-production process for sublimated kit.





HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)



To be considered,
 me at 
 with this EXACT subject line:



    Sales Support Application - [Your Name] - Sublimation



Please include:



- Your CV.



- A cover letter of no more than 200 words.



- The Translation Task (below).





THE TRANSLATION TASK



A customer sends this request:



    "I want the jersey to feel 'aggressive' but 'clean.' Maybe some blue

    bits, and make the logo pop more."



In your
:

Finally, in two or three sentences, tell us about a time you caught a

small error before it became a costly problem.

instructions - including the exact subject line and the word limit - will

be set aside. We're looking for people who pay attention.

title: Mid-Level Operations Support
description:
About the company

We are recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing UK-based vehicle logistics tech company. They have built a platform that automates vehicle movement between dealerships and customers across the UK, cutting delivery times from over a week down to 24-48 hours. As their volume grows, they are building a dedicated operations support team to keep things running at that standard.



About the role

Every vehicle that moves through the platform has to be confirmed before a driver is ever dispatched. That confirmation has to be accurate. One wrong digit on a vehicle reference ID means a car cannot be picked up because it is not insured. A missed drop-off confirmation means a customer is waiting and the whole chain is delayed.



You will own this process end to end, working closely with the operations team, and you will be responsible for guiding and supporting a junior tea
mber alongside you.



Day to day, you will:

- Make outbound confirmation calls to dealerships, customers, and drivers before each vehicle collection and delivery

- Verify and cross-check vehicle details, catching and correcting any discrepancies before they cause delays

- Handle retail deliveries which require two separate calls - one to confirm collection and one to confirm the customer is available to receive the vehicle

- Sync with drivers on last-minute tasks or customer requests such as fueling, charging, or special handling

- Manage escalations and handle difficult conversations with professionalism and calm

- Identify patterns and flag opportunities to improve the confirmation process over time

- Oversee and support the junior tea
mber day to day



What we are looking for

- 3-5 years of experience in customer service, operations, or a similar role

- Excellent English communication, verbal and written - you will be speaking with UK dealerships, customers, and drivers daily

- Exceptional attention to detail - the accuracy of your work directly affects the whole operation

- Confident and empathetic on the phone, particularly in high-pressure or fast-moving situations

- Strong conflict resolution skills

- Experience in logistics, freight forwarding, or transport is a strong advantage - if you have worked for companies like Flexport or similar, we want to hear from you

Work setup requirements

title: Senior Website & CRO Strategist

About the Company

Ikigai Cases (
) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father’s neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we’ve built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe.



Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail.



About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Website & CRO Strategist to take complete ownership of our website, CRO, and landing page operations - as both the strategist who sets the roadmap and the lead builder who ships against it.



This is a true player-coach role. You’ll diagnose where the funnel is leaking, build the test roadmap, and then drive execution forward yourself — hands-on in Replo, Shopify, and Intelligems — while leading a small team (an internal website manager and an external developer) to move faster than you could alone. Strategy and production aren’t separate tracks here. We’re hiring someone who is genuinely excellent at both and wants to keep their hands on the work, not someone who writes briefs and waits.



You’ll run this like your own business unit, working directly with the founder — no layers of management, full autonomy over your domain. If you’ve scaled a DTC CRO program / website team before and want to own the whole thing end to end, this is that role.



5 Core Responsibilities

1. CRO Strategy & Roadmap — Own the testing roadmap end to end: diagnose where the funnel leaks, form prioritized hypotheses, and d
 what we test next and why.

2. Funnel Strategy & Optimization — Design and optimize custom funnels for paid traffic — persona- and offer-specific experiences built to convert Meta spend.

3. Website & Landing Pages Production Lead — Own production of landing pages, PDP updates, and site changes — directing the team and getting hands-on yourself in Replo and Intelligems when the work calls for it.

4. Team Leadership & Developer Management — Lead the website manager and external developer as a hands-on player-coach, keeping the roadmap shipping on time.

5. Cross-Functional Alignment — Keep ads, landing pages,
, and merchandising working as one system alongside the marketing team,
 agency, and customer service.



Why You Should Take This Role

-You’ll be working at a brand that is obsessed with their customers and has built a loyal following. Just read a few of their reviews: 

-You’ll be working at a company that has scaled rapidly in just 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth. Our goal is to make the best pill cases in the world.

-You’ll be working with people who have extreme levels of competitive fire in their bellies — people who will run through walls to make sure the company succeeds.

-You’ll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain.

-You’ll be working to make people’s lives easier with products they’ll use every single day. The company was founded to solve a personal problem the founder’s father had with his pill organizers while battling a neurological condition for a decade.



Required Experience & Skills

-4+ years working for a CRO Agency / DTC E-commerce Brand / Growth Agency.

-Experience building a CRO roadmap, planning & executing on A/B tests.

-Experience developing funnels for paid acquisition — building custom experiences for specific personas or specific offers to support paid media spend.

-Experience leading & managing execution, not just recommending strategy. Must be willing to get your hands dirty on production when needed, not just tell others what to do.

-Software experience with Intelligems (A/B testing) and Replo (or similar landing page builders).



Nice-to-Have Experience

-Consumer durables / one-time-purchase product experience (NOT CPG / LTV / subscription).

-Notion fluency (this is our operating system).

-EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) familiarity.

-Paid Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year.

title: Reverse Recruiter | Career Services | Customer Support
description:
Career Services Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)



We run an AI-powered platform that automatically matches and applies to jobs on behalf of job seekers. The platform works best when there's strong alignment between a client's resume, their job titles, and the roles they're targeting. When that alignment is right, clients are getting 5-10 interviews per month. When it's off, the tool underperforms. This role is responsible for getting that alignment right.



What you'll do:



Resume Analysis (following our framework):

- Compare each client's resume headline, job titles, and skills against their target role list

- Flag mismatches: titles that don't exist in the market, headlines that claim experience not supported by the resume, internal titles that recruiters won't search for

- Document findings in a standard template



Platform Expertise and Job Market Verification:

- Become an expert in our platform and use it as the primary tool for verifying whether target roles are available and being matched correctly

- Provide feedback when the platform is missing roles or returning poor matches

- Use external job boards (LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor) when needed to confirm whether a role is missing from our platform or is uncommon in the market



New Client Intake and Ongoing Maintenance:

- Proactively check for new client accounts and begin analysis without waiting to be assigned

- Monitor existing client accounts to ensure alignment stays current as job markets shift

- Volume varies by day, from a handful of reviews up to 30



Recommendation Drafts:

- Prepare a summary of recommended changes: titles to add, titles to remove, resume edits needed

- Draft client-facing messages for review before sending

- Once approved, execute changes to resumes and search configurations

- Flag clients where we may not be a good fit for their target roles rather than forcing recommendations that won't work. Escalate these internally



Coach Communication (after ramp-up):

- Present recommendations to career coaches who manage client relationships. These coaches are experienced professionals who expect you to know the job market and back up your recommendations with evidence

- Answer follow-up questions about title changes and resume edits

- Ask for internal support when a client's industry or role is outside your knowledge area



Required:



- Excellent written English. Your writing goes directly to US-based clients and experienced career coaches. This is non-negotiable

- 2+ years in recruiting, HR, resume review, career services, or talent acquisition

- Ability to follow a defined process consistently, even on high-volume days

- Comfortable doing online research when needed to verify job availability

- Proactive work style. You'll be checking for new clients and monitoring accounts, not waiting for tasks to be assigned

- Available during US business hours for at least 4 hours of overlap



Nice to have (we can teach these quickly):



- Proficiency with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity). We'll train you on how to use these for research and drafting

- Familiarity with US job titles, hiring norms, and how ATS systems work. We have reference materials and frameworks for this

- Knowledge of specific industries. Our process and templates will guide you through unfamiliar sectors

- Resume formatting and document editing. Helpful but not the core skill

- Experience with specific job boards. Only used for spot-checking, not primary workflow



This role starts with all work reviewed before it reaches clients. As you demonstrate consistent quality, you'll take on more direct coach and client communication.



Remote. ~$1,000 /month, depending on experience. Part-time to start, potential full-time.

title: Content Operations VA For Men’s Coaching Brand (Full Time, Long Term)
description:
READ THIS FIRST: THIS IS A SYSTEMS + SOCIAL MEDIA ROLE, NOT A BASIC “POSTING ONLY” JOB



I’m Stefan, founder of Status Alpha, a high-ticket mentorship for men who want elite body, energy, mindset and performance.



I already built a detailed Content Operating System (folders, trackers, SOPs, Loom trainings). I shoot content and drop it into Google Drive. I need a Content Operations VA who loves structure AND loves social media, and can run the machine so I don’t have to think about it.



Your mission: take every video I drop into Drive and, using my SOPs and AI tools, turn it into organized assets and scheduled posts across all major social media platforms.



Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and even X/Twitter.



This is a full-time, long-term role for someone in the Philippines with strong written English, real experience supporting coaches/creators, and a genuine interest in growing social media brands.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Take raw videos from a Google Drive INBOX and:

  - Upload to transcription tools

  - Paste transcripts into Google Docs

  - Fix grammar, misheard words and punctuation so it reads like a native wrote it



- Use AI tools (I provide access and prompts) to:

  - Generate structured editor briefs

  - Pull hooks, clip ideas and timestamps



- Create and maintain Clip Briefs for the editor:

  - Fill meta info, link to source files, paste AI briefs

  - Add simple thumbnail notes (text plus which folder to pull photos from)



- Coordinate with the editor:

  - Move assets through Raw -> Briefed -> Editing -> Needs Revision -> Approved

  - Watch drafts, write clear revision notes, and approve final versions



- Organize assets in Google Drive:

  - Keep RAW vs PROOF vs Stefan Asset Bank clean

  - Follow naming conventions and folder structures



- Schedule and publish content using native schedulers / tools on:

  - Instagram and

  - TikTok

  - YouTube Shorts and long form

  - LinkedIn

  - X /



- Log monthly performance in a simple sheet:

  - Add top performing posts with their metrics

  - Write 3–10 short learnings (patterns, not complex analytics)



You get Looms and SOPs for all of this. Your job is to follow them, improve small things, and keep everything on time. Over time, I want you to see what works and help us double down on winning content.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



- You will not be the face of the brand.

- You will not be the closer or main DM setter.

- You will not be asked to invent the entire marketing strategy from scratch.

- You will not be left guessing what to do.



REQUIREMENTS (MUST HAVES)



- Written English: 9/10 or close. You can clean transcripts and captions without AI.

- Experience running content for at least one coach or creator (content calendar, Google Drive, editor/designer coordination, scheduling posts).

- You actually like SOPs, Loom trainings and checklists.

- You are genuinely interested in social media and content – you follow creators, notice what works, and care about views, watch time and growth.



- Strong with:

  - Google Drive, Docs, Sheets

  - Basic Canva (thumbnails or simple graphics)

  - Simple video editor (CapCut or similar for trimming and cropping)

  - At least one social media scheduler (Meta Business Suite, GoHighLevel, Metricool, Hootsuite, or native schedulers on TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X)



- Extremely organized, detail oriented, and reliable.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



- 35–40 hours per week

- Philippines evenings preferred (to overlap with US time)

- Light weekend coverage (1–3 hours Sat/Sun) for checks and urgent tasks



Pay:

- Starting USD 500–700 per month depending on experience and skill

- Long term, full time role if we are a good fit

- Room to grow if you perform and take full ownership



WHO THIS IS FOR



- You have already helped a coach or creator keep their content organized and consistent.

- You get satisfaction from clean systems, on-time posts and zero chaos.

- You like social media and want to help grow a brand with content.

- You want a stable, long-term role where you become “the person who runs the content machine.”



HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW EXACTLY)



Subject line: STATUS ALPHA CONTENT OS VA – [Your First Name]



In your message include short answers to:



1) Experience

- Briefly describe the best coach or creator you worked with and what you did for their content day to day.



2) Transcripts and English

- On a scale of 1–10, how strong is your written English (without AI)?

- In 3–5 sentences, tell me why you can be trusted to fix transcripts for important videos.



3) Tools

- Which tools have you used for:

  a) Transcription

  b) Scheduling posts

  c) Google Drive organization

  d) Video editing (if any)



4) Hours and pay

- How many hours per week can you commit?

- Are you able to work PH evenings plus some weekend time?

- What monthly salary (within 500–700 USD) would you be happy with long term?



5) Proof

- Links or screenshots from one coach or creator you supported (social accounts, a Drive structure screenshot with names blurred, or anything that shows you have done this).



Applications that do not follow these steps will be ignored. I am looking for one person who wants to own this role for the long term and run the system with pride.

title: Shopify VA for Product Uploads & Product Page Optimisation
description:
I am looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help manage our product upload and product page optimisation workflow.



This is a long-term role for someone who is comfortable using Shopify, following clear systems, working with AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Higgsfield, and making sure product pages are completed to a high standard.



What You’ll Be Doing



For the first week, we will send you around 50 product links per day. Your role will be to run each product through our provided Claude workflow, monitor the process carefully, and make sure everything is completed correctly before the product page is finalised.



Claude will handle the main product listing work, including the product title, description, product details, and other core listing information. Your job is not to manually write the main product titles or descriptions from scratch.



Instead, you will be responsible for overseeing Claude’s output, following any issues or instructions Claude gives you, checking that the product page is accurate, and making sure everything is completed properly before publishing or moving on to the next product.



You will also be responsible for optimising product pages after Claude has created the listing. We will show you exactly how this needs to be done so every product page matches our store standards and looks clean, professional, and trustworthy.



You will also need to check the product images carefully. All product images must have a clean white background. If Claude generates an image incorrectly, you will need to regenerate the image using Higgsfield. If an image does not have a white background, you will need to use ChatGPT to generate or fix the image so it matches our store standards.



Once you become familiar with our store, product style, and the types of products we sell, you will gradually start finding suitable product links yourself and running them through the same process.



Main Responsibilities



Run product links through our Claude workflow



Monitor Claude’s output and follow any instructions or issues it gives you



Oversee the product upload process inside Shopify



Optimise product pages after the listing has been created



Check product images and make sure they have a white background



Regenerate incorrect images using Higgsfield when needed



Use ChatGPT to fix or generate images when the background is not suitable



Check that product pages look clean, accurate, and professional



Follow our process carefully and consistently



Eventually help find suitable product links for the store



Maintain a high standard across all products added to the website



What We’re Looking For



Experience using Shopify



Comfortable using Claude, ChatGPT, Higgsfield, or similar AI tools



Strong attention to detail



Able to follow instructions carefully



Good eye for clean product pages and store presentation



Reliable, honest, and consistent with daily tasks



Able to work independently after training



Able to check AI-generated work instead of blindly trusting it



Experience with pet products, dropshipping, Google Shopping, or SEO is a bonus, but not required



Important Standards



We care about quality. Product pages should not look rushed, messy, copied, or generic. Every product needs to be checked carefully and presented in a way that feels trustworthy to customers.



Speed is important, but accuracy matters more. Once trained, you should be able to process around 50 products per day and optimise the product pages while keeping a high standard.



About the Role



This will start with a training and onboarding period where we provide the product links, Claude prompts, examples, and instructions. You will learn what our product pages should look like and how our workflow works.



After that, the role will become more independent. You will manage the product workflow, oversee Claude’s output, optimise product pages, check product images, fix image issues when needed, and eventually help find suitable products for the store.



How to Apply



Please apply with:



A short explanation of your Shopify experience



Examples or links to stores or product pages you have worked on before, if available



A brief explanation of your experience using Claude, ChatGPT, Higgsfield, or other AI tools



Confirmation that you are comfortable processing around 50 products per day and optimising product pages once trained



Reply with the word GREEN at the top of your application so we know you have read the full job post.

title: Vibe Coder – Remote On-the-Job Training (OJT)
description:
Location: Remote (Philippines-based)

Duration: 6-month OJT (potential full-time conversion)

Hours: 40 hours/week

Stipend: TBD (open for discussion based on experience)

Updated: June 2026



THE ROLE

You'll be building the actual software that runs our ventures — and learning how real software gets shipped in a

live, fast-moving business environment.

We don't have time for slow sprints. We have more ideas than hands. Dashboards our clients demand. Internal

tools our teams stitch together in spreadsheets. Client-facing portals that need to exist. Snap & Prospect

automation pipelines. And someone needs to make them real.

That someone is you — but we'll teach you how.



What you'll actually do:

• Build real, shipped tools — not homework projects. CRM enrichment scripts, onboarding workflows,

recruiter dashboards, automation glue between Gmail/Sheets/Telegram/Slack. You'll see your code running in

production within weeks, not months.

• Learn by doing — We'll pair you with our team on live builds. You'll see what good code looks like (and what

bad code looks like). You'll learn when an AI is being helpful vs. when it's confidently wrong. You'll ship messy

v1s and iterate based on real feedback.

• Own the full loop — Spec (usually from a Slack message or voice note), build, deploy, iterate. We give

direction; you ship.

• Treat AI as a co-builder, not a crutch — Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf — these are your tools. You'll learn

to work with AI, not just at AI.

• Move fast — When someone says "what if we…", you'll prototype something demo-able in a day or two, not

request a Gantt chart



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You don't need 5 years of experience. You need the right foundation and mindset.

Must-have:

? Technically capable — You've built something that ran. A side project. A class assignment you actually

finished. A startup idea you coded. It doesn't need to be polished; it needs to be real.

? AI-native — You think in AI. You use Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor daily. You can articulate your actual

workflow (not "I sometimes use Copilot"). You're comfortable asking an LLM for code and know how to spot

when it's lying.

? Systems thinking — Either you're a CS/IT student or recent grad who understands databases, APIs, and

deployment, OR you're a business/entrepreneurship student who's built a venture or prototype and understands

how systems need to work to solve real problems.

? Hunger to ship — You get frustrated by endless meetings. You want to see your work in the world. You're

willing to learn in public.

? Communication — Half our briefs come as voice notes. You're okay with ambiguity and can ask clarifying

questions without needing a 30-page spec.

Nice to have:

? You've built something with Claude Code or Cursor and can talk about what worked/didn't

? You're comfortable with: Next.js, React Native, FastAPI, Node, Supabase, Vercel

? You've touched:
 bots, Gmail/Drive APIs, automation tools (n8n, Make, Zapier)

? You understand business tools: CRMs (HubSpot, Pipedrive), recruiting ops, or SME workflows

? You're based in the Philippines and understand SEA or Australian SME operations



THE OJT ADVANTAGE

This isn't a typical internship. You're not making coffee or organizing files.

? You'll ship real code to real users within your first month

? You'll learn modern development the way it's actually done in 2026 — with AI as a first-class teammate

? You'll work across the full stack — no "frontend only" silos; you'll touch API design, database schemas,

deployment, customer feedback loops

? You'll build a portfolio of deployed projects you can show future employers

? You'll earn a stipend (negotiable) + potential full-time offer at the end if it's a good fit

? You'll be paid for your time — not exploited as free labor



HOW TO APPLY

Send us:

1. A short note (200 words max) on:

• The most interesting thing you've built (could be a hackathon project, class assignment, side project, startup

idea)

• What it does

• What tools you used (especially if you used AI)

• What you'd do differently if you built it again

2. Show your work:

• GitHub links (even half-finished projects)

• Deployed apps or links to live projects

• Screenshots, demo videos, or Loom walkthroughs

• If you built something with Claude Code or Cursor, please include it

3. Optional but encouraged (60–90 minutes):

Pick one and build it using Claude Code, Cursor, or your favorite AI-native tool. Don't polish it. Send us the

messy version + a 2-minute Loom walkthrough explaining what you built and what you'd change.

Option A: A CSV-to-personalized
 generator (upload contacts ? generate personalized drafts)

Option B: A
 bot that logs voice notes into a Google Sheet with auto-generated summaries

Option C: A mini dashboard that pulls from a public API (weather, crypto prices, GitHub repos, whatever) and

displays something useful



Send your code + Loom to:

title: Customer Support Specialist — Supplement Brands | Zendesk + Shopify + Loop (Long-Term, Scaling to Full-Time)
