Not looking to train someone from scratch. I need someone who already knows what it feels like to open Zendesk in the morning, see 80+ tickets waiting, and just start clearing — subscriptions, delivery issues, refunds, chargebacks, angry customers, legal threats — all of it, without needing someone over your shoulder.



If you've spent years supporting supplement or wellness brands through Zendesk and Shopify, using Loop or Seal Subscriptions — this will feel familiar from Day 1.



What you'll actually be doing:



— Opening Zendesk, picking up tickets, and resolving them end-to-end

— Running subscription cancellations through a multi-step retention flow — Step 1 (ask why + offer benefits), Step 2 (offer pause/skip/frequency change), Step 3 (provide cancellation portal), through to final cancellation — exactly the way you've done it before

— Catching legal trigger words — attorney, lawyer, BBB, FTC, dispute, chargeback, court, consumer protection — and switching to immediate resolution without hesitation

— Checking Shopify order history, verifying subscription status in Loop or Seal, searching by
 + name + username across multiple stores before responding

— Handling delivery issues — tracking via 17track or USPS, providing updates with tracking links, managing "delivered but not received" cases

— Processing refunds (full and partial), managing chargeback responses, and de-escalating frustrated customers with warmth and professionalism

— Using pre-built macros for speed while adjusting tone to match each customer's situation

— Signing off with your name, professional formatting, clean structure — every time



If you just read that list and thought "that's literally my current job" — keep reading.



What makes this different from your current role:



— You work directly with the brand owner (me). No middle management, no agency layers, no confusion about who to ask

— I give real, specific feedback — not just "do better." I'll tell you exactly which ticket, which step, and why

— Your hours grow as fast as you prove yourself. This starts at 1 hour/day and scales to full-time. I've done this before — the right person gets more hours within weeks, not months

— Bonuses for consistently clean work. Not a maybe — a real part of how we operate

— Weekly PayPal payouts every Tuesday. No chasing invoices, no delays



The details:



— Starting rate: $5–6/hr depending on experience (willing to pay more for someone who's been doing this 3+ years)

— Hours: 1 hr/day to start, scaling to 4–6 hrs/day, and eventually full-time

— Schedule: Flexible within 9am–7pm CT — you pick your window

— Tools: Zendesk (macros + views), Shopify (order lookup + admin), Loop or Seal Subscriptions, 

— Payout: Weekly via PayPal (Tuesdays)



What I need from you (non-negotiable):



— 3+ years of daily Zendesk experience — real queue work, not "I've seen it"

— Real Shopify experience — order lookup, subscription verification, navigating multiple stores

— Hands-on experience with Loop Subscriptions, Seal Subscriptions, or Recharge — actually cancelling, pausing, skipping, modifying subscriptions in the backend

— Previous experience supporting supplement, wellness, or health brands — you understand the customer profile and product type

— You can handle 50+ tickets/hour using macros

— You catch legal keywords every single time — attorney, BBB, FTC, lawsuit, dispute, court — and you know exactly what to do when you see them

— Strong written English — warm, clear, professional, no copy-paste robotics

— Reliable internet + quiet workspace



Why people stay with us:



I'm not going to pitch you on culture or mission statements. Here's the truth: I pay on time, I communicate clearly, I respect your time, and I give you room to grow. The right person here isn't just clearing tickets — they're building something with me. I want someone who's looking for that.



How to apply:



Send me:



1. A short note about your experience — specifically which supplement or wellness brands you've supported, which subscription platform you've used (Loop, Seal, Recharge), and how long you've been using Zendesk daily

2. Your resume

3. A screenshot of your internet speed test



If your experience matches, I'll send you a few screening questions and a short practical test. No tricks — just real tickets, real scenarios, showing me you can do what you already know how to do.



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



– Gavin

 what gets taught, how the curriculum is structured, or how the learning experience is designed. Those decisions have already been made.



Their job is to take finished materials and turn them into polished learner-facing assets.



I'd redefine the role around that reality.



---



The Role



You will be responsible for producing the final learner-facing media and resources including videos and PDFs.



Working from AI-generated presenter videos, production briefs and established templates, you will assemble finished class videos, create supporting visual elements, and produce downloadable learning resources.



Your role is to ensure that all learner-facing content is professionally produced, visually coherent, engaging and consistent with the studio's quality standards.



You will become the final stage of the production process before content is published.



---



Core Responsibilities



Video Editing & Assembly



Take AI-generated presenter footage created in platforms such as Synthesia and HeyGen and assemble it into completed class videos.



This includes:



* Editing and sequencing video segments

* Managing pacing and flow

* Adding titles and lower thirds

* Adding captions and on-screen text

* Integrating motion graphics

* Incorporating diagrams and visual aids

* Sourcing and integrating b-roll footage

* Adding transitions and visual polish

* Ensuring consistency across all lessons



Work primarily with Adobe: Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop



---



Motion Graphics & Visual Elements



Create simple but professional motion graphics that enhance understanding and engagement.



Examples include:



* Animated diagrams

* Timelines

* Framework visualisations

* Process maps

* On-screen callouts

* Text animations

* Lesson openers and closers



The goal is clarity and professionalism rather than flashy animation.



---



Worksheet & Resource Production



Create learner resources using established templates and brand guidelines.



This may include:



* Worksheets

* Reflection exercises

* Planning templates

* Checklists

* Implementation guides

* Course handouts

* Downloadable resources



Ensure resources are visually appealing, easy to use and consistent with studio standards.



---



Visual Asset Creation



Create supporting graphics and visual assets for courses where required.



Examples include:



* Infographics

* Process diagrams

* Icons

* Course thumbnails

* Presentation graphics

* Resource illustrations



Use a combination of design tools and AI-assisted creative tools where appropriate.



---



Production Quality Control



Review all assets before publication.



Ensure consistency across:



* Visual style

* Branding

* Typography

* Layout

* Naming conventions

* Production quality



Maintain a professional and polished learner experience across the entire platform.



---



### Essential Skills



* Strong video editing skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Experience with Premiere Pro (or equivalent)

* Basic motion graphics capability

* Strong visual design judgement

* Ability to follow brand and template guidelines

* Strong organisational skills

* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously



---



### Desirable Skills



* After Effects

* Canva

* Photoshop

* Illustrator

* Figma

* Experience creating educational content

* Familiarity with AI media tools

* Experience working with online course platforms



---



### What Success Looks Like



Every lesson feels professionally produced.

Video content is clear, engaging and visually polished.

Motion graphics help understanding rather than distract from it.

Worksheets and resources are attractive, practical and consistent.

Learners experience a seamless visual identity across the entire studio.

The production quality of the content significantly increases the perceived value of the membership.



About Us



The Coaches Business Studio and Coloqia are part of a growing family of education businesses created by the team behind Animas.



Founded in 2008, Animas is one of the world's leading coach training schools, having trained thousands of coaches across more than 90 countries. Over the past decade, the organisation has built a reputation for high-quality professional education, thoughtful learning design and innovative approaches to coach development.



Behind the scenes, we are supported by an experienced Filipino operations and production team that has been working together since 2017. This team has played a central role in the growth and success of Animas and now forms the operational foundation for our newer ventures.



The Coaches Business Studio and Coloqia represent the next stage of that evolution. Both are specialist education platforms built around AI-avatar-led learning, combining expert-designed curricula, modern production methods and emerging AI technologies to create flexible, scalable learning experiences.



Although these ventures use new technologies and new delivery models, they are built by the same team, guided by the same commitment to educational quality, learner experience and long-term thinking that has shaped Animas over many years.

title: Meta Ads Expert Video Editor — E-Commerce Ads at Scale
description:
We're looking for a video editor who understands one thing clearly:

A good ad doesn't just look nice. It stops the scroll, holds attention, builds desire, and gets people to take action.

We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand selling K-beauty skincare products to women over 40. We currently sell in Italy and we're actively expanding across Europe, with new markets launching soon. Paid social is one of our main growth channels — which means video creative is not just "content" for us, it's one of the biggest drivers of the business.

We're looking for an editor who can help us create high-performing video ads for
, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid channels — and who can do it using a modern, AI-driven workflow that lets us move fast, test more, and scale creative volume without sacrificing quality.

This role is ideal for someone who understands direct-response editing, UGC-style ads, AI-generated creative, fast testing, strong hooks, emotional storytelling, and conversion-focused creative for e-commerce.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE EDITING ---

You'll be working on video ads designed specifically for e-commerce performance, including:

—
 and Instagram ads: scroll-stopping videos built to grab attention quickly and drive purchases

— UGC-style ad creatives, both real and AI-generated: native-feeling videos that look organic, believable, and platform-friendly

— AI talking-head and avatar-based ads: built using tools like HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and similar

— Product demonstration videos: clear, benefit-driven edits that show the product in action

— Customer testimonial ads: emotional, trust-building edits using reviews, before/after 
nts, and social proof

— VSL-style ads and advertorial videos: longer-form sales videos built around education and direct-response structure

— Creative variations for testing: different hooks, openings, captions, CTAs, angles, pacing, and structures

— Localized creatives for new European markets as we expand



--- WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ---

We're not looking for a "cinematic" editor who only cares about pretty visuals.

We're looking for someone who understands how e-commerce ads work AND how to leverage AI to create them at scale.

You should know how to edit videos that:

— Stop people in the first 1–3 seconds

— Make the problem feel real and urgent

— Show the product clearly and persuasively

— Use captions, cuts, zooms, overlays, and b-roll to maintain attention

— Feel native to
, Instagram, and TikTok

— Communicate benefits quickly and clearly

— Build trust using reviews, testimonials, and social proof

— Guide the viewer toward a click or purchase on our Shopify store

You should be able to take a script, raw footage, UGC clips, product shots, reviews, references, AND AI-generated assets, then turn them into a polished ad ready for testing.



--- AI WORKFLOW (NON-NEGOTIABLE) ---

This is a core part of the role, not a bonus. You should be confident in:

— Generating UGC-style AI avatars and talking-head content (HeyGen, Higgsfield, or similar)

— Generating AI voiceovers in multiple languages and tones (ElevenLabs or similar)

— Generating AI b-roll, supplementary visuals, and scene fillers when stock or original footage isn't enough

— Knowing which tool to use for which job — and combining them efficiently inside a single edit

— Optimizing tool credits and subscription costs: every generation has a real cost, and we need someone who knows how to get the best output with the fewest wasted credits

— Iterating quickly when an AI generation doesn't land, without burning through resources

— Blending AI-generated content with real footage so the final ad feels native and believable, not artificial

If you've never touched these tools or you're not comfortable working in an AI-driven pipeline, this role isn't the right fit.



--- THE KIND OF EDITOR WHO WILL THRIVE HERE ---

You'll be a strong fit if you:

— Have experience editing video ads for e-commerce brands (beauty, skincare, or DTC is a strong plus)

— Understand direct-response marketing and paid social creative

— Have hands-on experience with AI generation tools (avatars, voice, b-roll)

— Can create multiple ad variations quickly

— Know how to follow references without copying them blindly

— Have a good instinct for hooks, pacing, retention, and emotional flow

— Can make simple footage feel compelling and conversion-focused

— Are resourceful with AI tools and credit budgets

— Are comfortable receiving feedback and iterating fast

— Care about whether your videos actually perform, not just whether they look good

We care about creative that sells. That doesn't mean ugly or low-quality. It means every editing choice — and every AI generation — should support the message, the emotion, and the conversion.



--- SKILLS & EXPERIENCE ---

Ideally, you have experience with:

— Meta/Facebook ad creatives for e-commerce brands

— Short-form paid social videos

— Long-form VSLs or sales videos

— AI-generated UGC, avatar, and b-roll content

— Captioning, motion graphics, overlays, b-roll, sound design, and pacing

— Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci, or similar tools

— HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, Runway, Kling, or similar AI generation platforms

Bonus if you've worked with beauty, skincare, or K-beauty brands targeting a female audience over 40.



--- WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY ---

— Editing new ad creatives from scripts, footage, UGC clips, AI-generated assets, and references

— Generating AI b-roll, avatars, and voiceovers as part of the production pipeline

— Creating variations of winning ads for further testing

— Improving hooks, pacing, captions, visuals, and CTAs

— Adapting creatives for different platforms and aspect ratios (Reels, Stories, Feed, TikTok)

— Building localized variations of winning ads for new European markets as we expand

— Managing AI tool usage efficiently to keep production costs under control

— Collaborating with the marketing and creative team to improve performance

— Using feedback from ad results to make stronger iterations



--- WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU ---

— Competitive compensation based on experience

— Performance-based bonuses for strong creatives

— Access to premium AI tools and platforms — fully covered by us

— The opportunity to work on ads that directly drive e-commerce revenue across multiple European markets

— Clear creative direction and fast feedback

— Long-term growth with a fast-scaling D2C brand expanding internationally

We're building a serious e-commerce brand, and we're looking for an editor who knows how to create ads that get attention, build trust, and convert — using both classic direct-response editing instincts and the AI tools that make modern creative production possible at scale.

If you're an e-commerce ad video editor who understands performance creative AND lives in the AI workflow, we'd love to hear from you.



--- READY TO APPLY? ---

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Instead, you’ll be part of the team, learning across different areas of the business, gaining new skills, and building something meaningful together.

title: Client Support/Account Manager
description:
Get to know who we serve before you apply:


 




 

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



Most "support" roles are a ticket queue. A client complains, you copy-paste a reply, you close the ticket, you forget the human.



Market Leaders doesn't work that way.



Our clients are high-performing operators — property agents, financial advisors, business owners — who pay us to help them grow. They don't need a help desk. They need someone in their corner who keeps them on track, removes the friction, and finds the thing they couldn't find themselves.



That's you.



You're the person who notices a client has gone quiet and reaches out before they fall behind. You're the one who walks them through the tool they're stuck on. You're the one who, when a client says "I can't figure out how to do X," just... handles it.



If you're genuinely tech-savvy, genuinely organised, and you actually like helping people win — read on.



This is a fully remote role for someone who takes ownership, not someone who waits for tickets.

ABOUT MARKET LEADERS

Market Leaders is a Singapore-based social media consulting company. We help high-performing operators turn their expertise into content and systems that compound.



We work with:

- **Property agents** doing $500M+ in transactions, leading 30+ agent teams

- **Financial advisors** running established lead and ad systems

- **Business owners + coaches** building personal brands that drive real revenue



We teach the 5 C's — Character, Content, Community, Convert, Client — and we believe in systems, not willpower. Peaceful and profitable.



Here's the truth about coaching: the clients who get results are the ones who keep showing up and doing the work. Your job is to make that easy — to keep them accountable, unblock them on the tech, and be the reliable hand they can reach for. You protect the client relationship so our coaches and founders can focus on the coaching.

TOTAL COMPENSATION PACKAGE



**Base Salary:** SGD $800-1,000/month (paid via Wise or PayPal in SGD)

Range depends on experience and how much you can own from day one.



**What's Included**

- Fully remote — work from anywhere, as long as you overlap Singapore working hours (SGT)

- Direct training on our tools, our AI bots, our client systems, and how we work

- Exposure to how a real coaching business runs — the systems behind the scenes

- The tools you need to do the job well



**Work Benefits**

- Results-focused — we judge whether clients stay on track and feel supported, not your hours online

- Clear playbooks so you're never guessing how to handle something

- A role where being proactive and resourceful is the whole point, not a bonus



**Path Forward**

- Prove you can own the client relationship, and the scope grows — more clients, more responsibility, a senior customer-success track

- This is a long-term seat for the right person, not a gig

THE 4Rs — YOUR ROLE BREAKDOWN

### 1. ROLE — The Mission



Be the accountability and support layer for Market Leaders' clients.



You keep clients on track with what they committed to, you help them with the tech and tools they get stuck on, and you find the things they can't find for themselves. You're the reliable, proactive hand that makes the client experience feel handled.



Every interaction serves one objective: the client keeps moving forward, feels supported, and stays with us because the experience is excellent.



You'll use our AI tools and systems to help clients faster — but the care, the follow-through, and the judgment are yours.



### 2. RESPONSIBILITIES — The Day-to-Day Work



**Accountability & Check-ins — 35%**

- Track what each client committed to (from their coaching calls, client chart, and ongoing chats)

- Work inside client chats — reach out proactively, nudge, follow up, and check in before things slip

- Run a consistent weekly check-in rhythm with clients

- Log progress so the coaches and founders always know where each client stands



**Tech Support & Enablement — 30%**

- Help clients set up and use our tools, AI bots, portal, and the software they need

- Troubleshoot when something isn't working, calmly and clearly

- Run short screen-share walkthroughs when a client is stuck

- Write simple how-to guides so the same question doesn't come up twice



**Concierge & Research — 20%**

- Find the things clients can't find — resources, templates, vendors, answers, examples

- Do light research on the client's behalf so they don't lose time hunting

- Be the "let me sort that out for you" person clients come to rely on



**CRM Hygiene & Escalation — 15%**

- Keep the client chart, records, notes, and statuses clean and up to date

- Flag at-risk or quiet clients early

- Escalate the right things to coaches or founders — with context, not just "client's upset"



### 3. RESULTS — What Success Looks Like



**Foundation Phase — Month 1**

- Know the client roster, their commitments, and the tools they use

- Hit a consistent response time on every client message

- Learn our systems, AI bots, and playbooks well enough to handle common questions solo

- Run your first round of weekly check-ins



*This phase is about learning the clients, the tools, and the rhythm.*



**Growth Phase — Month 3**

- Own the weekly accountability loop — clients are being followed up with, on time, every week

- Resolve most tech questions yourself without escalating

- Build a small library of how-to guides for the questions that repeat

- Spot at-risk clients early and flag them with useful context



*This phase is where you stop reacting and start running the support engine.*



**Long-Term Impact — Month 6**

- Measurably lift client follow-through — clients are doing what they committed to

- Noticeably cut the number of routine questions reaching the founders and coaches

- Be the trusted point of contact clients reach for first

- Own the client-experience playbook and keep improving it



*This phase is where the client experience runs as a system you own.*



### 4. REQUIREMENTS — The Must-Haves



**Experience**

- Prior customer-facing experience — customer success, account management, support, or client coordination

- A track record of being the reliable, proactive one — examples welcome

- Comfortable working directly with clients who are busy, successful, and expect competence



**Skills**

- Excellent written and spoken English — most of this job is clear communication

- Genuinely tech-savvy — you learn new software and AI tools fast and can troubleshoot calmly

- Strongly organised — you don't drop follow-ups, and nothing falls through the cracks

- Resourceful — when you don't know something, you find out, you don't just give up



**Work Arrangement**

- Fully remote, but you must overlap core Singapore working hours (SGT) for client responsiveness

- Reliable laptop and internet — clients are counting on you to be reachable

- Able to commit long-term, not a short gig



**Work Style**

- Ownership mentality — a client's progress is your responsibility, not just your task list

- Proactive — you reach out before you're asked, you don't wait for problems to escalate

- Calm and warm under pressure — clients should feel handled, not managed

- Open to feedback and fast iteration — you'd rather hear "do this better" than "this is fine"



WHAT MAKES YOU THE PERFECT FIT

**You Take Ownership**

You don't ask "did I reply?" You ask "is this client actually moving forward?" Their progress is your scoreboard.



**You're Genuinely Good with Tech**

New tool, new AI bot, unfamiliar software — you figure it out fast, and you can explain it to someone who can't. You're the person friends call when something won't work.



**You're Proactive, Not Reactive**

You notice the quiet client. You follow up before the deadline. You flag the problem while it's still small. Clients never have to chase you.



**You're Resourceful**

"I couldn't find it" isn't in your vocabulary. When a client needs something, you go find it, figure it out, or get the answer.



**You're Organised to a Fault**

You track every commitment and every follow-up. Nothing slips. Your notes are clean enough that anyone could pick them up.



**You're Warm Without Being a Pushover**

You can hold a client accountable and keep them feeling supported at the same time. You're a direct, caring mentor, not a doormat and not a drill sergeant.



**You Communicate Clearly**

Whether it's a check-in, a how-to, or an escalation, your message is clear, kind, and gets to the point.



HOW TO APPLY

**1.
**

Send your application to: 

Subject line: **Client Support / Account Manager — [Your Name]**



**2. Include These 3 Things**



**Relevant Experience**

- A short note on a client or customer relationship you owned, and what you did to keep them on track or solve a problem for them

- Any tools, software, or AI you're comfortable with (and how you've used them)



**Brief Response — 4 to 6 Sentences**



> *"A client tells you: 'I'm stuck — I can't get this tool to work and I'm falling behind on what I said I'd do this week.' Walk us through exactly how you'd handle it, start to finish. Be specific about what you'd say and what you'd do."*



This is the most important part of your application. We're hiring for ownership and judgment, not scripts. Generic answers = skipped application.



**Resume/CV**

PDF format only.



**3. Paid Trial — If Shortlisted**

We'll give you 3 sample client situations:

- An accountability nudge (a client who's gone quiet and is behind on a commitment)

- A tech question (a client stuck on one of our tools)

- A "can you find X for me" request



You'll write how you'd respond to each, and propose a simple weekly check-in cadence you'd run across a small client book.



- Turnaround: 48 hours from receipt of the brief

- Payment: **USD equivalent of SGD $40 via Wise or PayPal on submission**

- Paid regardless of outcome



The trial isn't testing whether you can write a polite reply. It's testing whether you can take ownership, communicate clearly, and actually solve the problem — including the tech.



**4. Interview**

- 30-minute video call with the Market Leaders team

- A short live scenario — we describe a client situation, you talk us through how you'd handle it

- Decision before offer

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

- Application review: within 3-5 business days

- Top candidates contacted: within 48 hours of decision

- Full process: application ? paid trial ? interview ? offer, within 2 weeks max



We do not drag this out. If you are a fit, you will know. If not, you'll get a respectful "not this cycle" reply within a week.



NOT A FIT IF

This role is not for you if:

- You want a passive ticket-queue job where you wait for problems to come to you

- You need someone watching over you to stay on task — remote means self-managed

- You're not actually comfortable with software and troubleshooting

- You drop follow-ups or let things fall through the cracks

- You can't overlap Singapore working hours for client responsiveness

- You'd rather avoid hard conversations than hold a client accountable

- You want a short gig, not a long-term seat



If any of those describe you, that's fine. We'd rather know upfront.

I am looking for a thoughtful, emotionally mature, detail-oriented, AI-savvy Strategic Marketing & Operations Virtual Assistant who can help me organize, launch, and grow this new line of business.



This is not a basic admin-only role. I need someone who can think strategically, follow directions, organize projects, and help turn my ideas into clear, polished, useful business assets.

Important: This business deals with grief, suicide loss, and emotionally sensitive topics. The person in this role must have strong judgment, confidentiality, compassion, and emotional maturity. You will not be expected to provide grief coaching, therapy, crisis support, or respond independently to sensitive client messages. Those messages must be flagged for me.

 marketing support experience

title: A-Player DM Setter For Men’s Coaching Brand (Performance-Based, Long Term)
description:
Read this carefully. If you’re just looking for “any VA job” or fixed hourly pay, this is not for you.



I’m Stefan, founder of Status Alpha – a high-ticket mentorship for men who want elite body, energy, mindset and performance.



We sell €3.5k–€20k coaching programs to men worldwide. Most clients come from DM conversations.



We already flood Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and X/Twitter with content. Inbound and outbound conversations are only going up.



I have a full Content Operating System and A-player closers.



Now I want an A-player setter whose only job is:

Start smart conversations. Qualify fast. Book calls. Get paid on results.



If that excites you, keep reading.



MISSION OF THE ROLE



Turn warm attention from my content into qualified booked calls for my sales team.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Own DMs on non-bot platforms (TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, maybe others).

- On Instagram/Facebook, take over stuck / high-intent leads when automations have done their part and a human is needed.

- Proactively initiate DMs with warm leads (engagers, commenters, voters) when directed by the team.

- Follow proven scripts and flows, adapt when needed, and track results.

- Be measured on:

  - Conversations started

  - Calls booked

  - Show-up rate

  - Sales from your sets



This is appointment setting, not closing. No cold calling, no “spray and pray”. You talk to people who already follow or engage with me.



DAY-TO-DAY



- Check all assigned platforms multiple times per day (TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, plus IG/FB stuck/high-intent leads).

- Reply to inbound messages using our scripts and training.

- Start DMs with warm leads:

  - People who comment with clear pain/interest

  - Story viewers / voters (when handed to you)

  - Engagers on high-performing posts that we flag for you

- Qualify leads using our questions (budget, problem, timeline, fit).

- Handle basic objections in DMs (time, “not sure”, “need to think”), and route serious buyers to a call.

- Book calls on the correct calendar with all required notes.

- Keep simple tracking of:

  - Who you talked to

  - Who booked from your DMs

  - Who showed up

  - Who bought (for commissions)

- Follow up old leads consistently.

- Occasionally reply to high-intent comments (“how do I work with you?”) and move them into DMs.

- Work closely with me and my team to improve scripts based on what you see in the field.



You will not create content or do generic admin. Your job is DMs and booking calls.



WHO THIS IS FOR



- You love sales conversations and messaging. DMs do not drain you.

- Written English is 9/10+. You sound natural, not robotic.

- You have proven experience as a DM setter / appointment setter / closer (bonus if it was for coaches, consultants or fitness).

- You can show proof (numbers, screenshots, client references, or case studies) that you have actually booked calls and driven revenue.

- You are hungry. You want uncapped income, not just a small fixed salary.

- You like being measured. Numbers do not scare you.

- You can work Philippines evenings to overlap with Dubai and US/Europe time zones.

- You are okay working 6 days/week with lighter Sundays.



Nice-to-have (not required):

- Certificates in appointment setting / sales. If you have them, send them.



NOT FOR YOU IF



- You are scared of rejection or pushback in DMs.

- You have zero sales reps and zero proof.

- You need someone to tell you what to do every minute.

- You are just collecting clients and will disappear in 30 days.



COMPENSATION



This is performance-driven.



- Base: 200–300 USD/month (depending on experience)

- Commission: 3–5% of cash collected from clients who buy after calls you set

  - Our programs are €3,500–€20,000

  - Even at the low end, 3–5% is about 110–300+ USD per sale



Realistic on-target earnings once ramped:

- 15–25+ calls booked/month

- 30–40% close rate by our closers

You can make 800–1,800+ USD/month once you are dialed in. There is no cap.



SCHEDULE



- About 35–40 hours/week spread across:

  - Mon–Sat: core setting hours in the evening PH time (to be agreed)

  - Sun: lighter check-ins and follow-ups



You must be available during agreed core hours, not “whenever”.



MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS



- At least 1 year of experience in appointment setting / DM setting / sales (coaching, agency, SaaS or similar).

- Very strong written English (we will test this).

- Stable internet + backup (data or second connection) and a quiet place to work.

- Comfortable using:

  - Instagram /
 / TikTok / LinkedIn / YouTube DMs

  - Google Sheets / basic CRM

  - Loom / Zoom for training

- Willing to follow proven scripts AND give feedback to improve them.



HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW EXACTLY)



1) Subject line / OnlineJobs title:

A-PLAYER SETTER – [Your First Name]



2) In your message, include short, direct answers to:



a) Briefly describe your best DM setting or sales experience (1–3 sentences).



b) What was your best month ever in terms of calls booked or revenue generated, and for what kind of offer? Share numbers.



c) On a scale of 1–10, how strong is your written English? Show me with 2–3 sentences selling me on why I should pick you.



d) What monthly income are you aiming for in USD within 3–6 months if you crush it here?



e) Confirm your typical working hours in PH time and your availability on Sat/Sun.



f) Attach or link proof that you’re a killer in DMs:

- Screenshots, metrics, or a simple breakdown (for example: “20 calls booked / 7 closes on $5k offer in one month”),

- Any certificates in setting/sales (optional but a plus).



3) OPTIONAL (big plus):

Record a 2–3 minute Loom or audio where you:

- Introduce yourself

- Tell me about a time you turned a dead lead into a booked call

- Explain why you’re the best choice for this role



Generic or copy-paste applications will be ignored. I am only looking for 1–2 killers who want to grow with the brand long term.



If you read this all the way down and you’re fired up, apply now.

title: SEO Content Operations Manager (QA and Editing)
description:
Good work should win the work.



Rootl helps trades and local service businesses get found, picked and booked online. We exist because good businesses lose to worse ones every day. Not because they're worse at the job, but because the worse ones got found first.



It started with advice from an upstairs window to a window cleaner halfway up a ladder. By 2036 we want Rootl to be the UK's most trusted local search company for trades, with our first US hub open.



We're building the team that gets us there. Want a seat on the bus?



WHAT WE DO

We help trades and local service businesses get found on Google, and inside the AI tools their next customer is already searching with: ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini. That is the job. We work with plumbers, gas engineers, roofers, joiners, plasterers, drainage crews, window firms, waste and pest control, architects, developers and taxi firms. We run three services, Essentials, Growth and Accelerator, all pointed at one thing: putting our client in front of the customer who is already searching.



THE ROLE, IN ONE LINE

You own how we deliver. You run our content production from brief to published page across every client, keeping the quality high and the pipeline moving.



READ THIS TWICE: THIS IS NOT A WRITING JOB

Our AI tools do the heavy drafting. We are not looking for a writer with flair. We need someone who can take a draft and make it genuinely client-ready. That means catching errors, tightening the copy, fixing the SEO, and making sure nothing wrong or sloppy ever reaches a client. The detail is the deliverable.



A STRAIGHT WORD ABOUT THIS ROLE

This is a brand new seat, and we are building it as we go. The founder needs to step out of the day to day and focus on where Rootl is heading and how we get there. That leaves a real gap, and it is yours to fill.



So be clear on what you are walking into. We are moving fast and we do not have every answer yet. Some weeks will feel like organised chaos. This role exists to bring order to it. If that excites you rather than worries you, and you are the sort who turns chaos into a clean, repeatable system, this is your seat. It is a rocket ship, and we want you on board.



WHY YOU'D WANT THIS SEAT

- A small, focused team built around getting one job done brilliantly. James runs sales and strategy. Our web developer builds the sites. You own the SEO content production system end to end. Three people, three clear lanes, no politics, no meetings about meetings.

- Real responsibility from day one. This is not a six-month shadow-the-founder role.

- The work is simple by design. It is a series of checklists. We want someone who finds that energising, not boring.

- You will not be slotted into someone else's process. You will write the process, recorded with the founder and turned into the Blueprints and SOPs every future Rootl hire is trained on.

- Real long-term upside for the person who stays the course. We will talk that through properly once you are established.

- Local search is shifting under everyone's feet right now. We are moving fast on it, and you will be at the front.

- We hire the right person, not the perfect person. Every candidate is DISC profiled, because the seat has to fit how we work.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Running our content agent and editing its output to a publish-ready standard

- Quality checking every page before it goes
 facts, spelling, grammar, British English, tone, and on-page SEO

- Working from SEO briefs and making sure each page does the job it is meant to do

- Managing our web developer: answering their questions, handing over finished pages, keeping the build on track

- Spotting local SEO improvements (Google Business Profile, on-page, internal links) and flagging them

- Owning the schedule: what is due, for which client, by when, and hitting it

- Running your part of our weekly tea
eting

- Taking our SOPs and making the process tighter over time



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- You spot a wrong town or city name, a missing full stop, or a clumsy sentence from a mile off. Detail is your thing.

- You would rather follow a proven checklist and run it well than reinvent the wheel each time.

- You take pride in doing similar work to a high standard, week in, week out.

- You check your own work before anyone else sees it. Things do not slip past you.

- You can take an SOP and run with it without being chased.

- You want a long-term home where you can own something, not a stepping stone.

- Excellent written British English. We will test this.

- Solid on-page SEO: titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links, alt text, basic schema.

- Comfortable editing AI-written content: cutting repetition, fixing flat phrasing, removing the AI tells, and fact-checking.



Nice to have, not essential:

- Local SEO or Google Business Profile experience

- Experience optimising content to get picked up by AI answers (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity)

- WordPress



TOOLS YOU WILL USE

Our content agent, WordPress, Google Workspace, Local Dominator, BrightLocal, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. Training and SOPs provided. You do not need every tool on day one, but you do need to learn fast.



HOURS, PAY AND HOW IT WORKS

- Part-time to start, around 10 to 15 hours a week, paid at $8 USD an hour.

- We start with a short unpaid test task so we can see how you work. If it goes well, you move onto a two-week paid trial, paid for the hours you actually work.

- Once you pass the trial, we guarantee 40 hours a month as a floor, so there is always a baseline you can count on. In practice you will usually do more. Your hours and your rate both grow as you prove yourself and as we sign more clients, and the aim is to build this into a full-time seat for the right person.

- If a client ever leaves and the work drops, we give you at least one week's written notice of any change to your hours.

- Paid weekly for your first month, then monthly after that, by Wise.

- You track your time in Toggl. Your tracked hours are what you invoice, so it stays clear and fair on both sides.

- Every Monday, without fail, we run a 30 minute tea
eting using the LIONS sheet. It is a simple one-page worksheet covering five things: Last week, Issues, Opportunities, the Next seven days, and Successes. You fill yours in and come ready to run your part. If you are ever away, you still send your completed sheet before the meeting. It keeps us aligned and the work on track.

- We work UK hours, 9:00 to 4:30. At least half your hours each week need to fall inside that window so we can work together properly. For you in the Philippines that is roughly 4pm to 11:30pm, so an evening pattern fits well.

- This is an independent contractor role on a proper written agreement covering confidentiality, client data, and how we pay you. You look after your own taxes in the Philippines, and you provide your own computer, reliable internet, and a quiet place to work.

- Four weeks' notice on either side if it is ever not working out.



HOW TO APPLY

- Start your application with the phrase "I spotted it" so we know you have read this far.

- Tell us, in a few lines, about a time you caught a mistake everyone else had missed.

- Share any examples of editing, proofreading, or SEO content work you are proud of.

- If you get through this first stage, we will send you a short test task: a real page with a few errors planted in it, for you to fix and explain. This first task is unpaid and the same for everyone. If it goes well, the paid trial follows.



A LAST WORD

We are not the biggest name out there, and we are not trying to be. We are here to show what local search looks like when it is done properly, and we want to be the best in the country at it. We are looking for the person who helps us get there. If you have read this far and something here lit you up, that is a good sign. We read every application that opens the right way. Show us why it should be you.



Want a seat on the bus?

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Role Overview



We are a growing digital marketing agency looking for a detail-oriented, reliable, and experienced Part-Time Bookkeeper to manage our accounts. This is a remote, ongoing position requiring approximately 5 hours per week.



You will be responsible for keeping our books clean, categorizing agency expenses (contractor payments, software subscriptions like BrightLocal/Local Dominator, and marketing costs), and ensuring our financial records are accurate and up-to-date.



Key Responsibilities



Expense Categorization: Accurately categorize all incoming and outgoing transactions weekly in Zoho Books (including recurring software subscriptions, payroll, and client payments).



Account Reconciliation: Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and payment processors (e.g., Stripe, PayPal) on a monthly basis.



Financial Reporting: Generate monthly Profit & Loss (P&L) statements and balance sheets so we can track our monthly margins.



Payroll Tracking: Keep track of hours and payments for our virtual assistant team.



Invoice Management: Monitor client subscription billings and flag any failed payments or outstanding invoices.



Required Skills & Experience



Experience: At least 2+ years of professional bookkeeping experience, preferably working with digital agencies, SaaS companies, or online service providers.



Tools: Expert-level knowledge of Zoho Books (experience with Zoho Expense or other tools in the Zoho suite is a major plus).



Detail-Oriented: Exceptional organizational skills. You should be someone who spots a $5 discrepancy and wants to solve it.



Communication: Excellent written English. Since this is a 5-hour-a-week role, clear and proactive communication via
 or Slack is vital.



Trustworthy: High level of integrity, as you will be dealing with sensitive financial data. (References may be requested).



Hours, Schedule & Compensation



Hours: Consistently 5 hours per week.



Schedule: Highly flexible. You can set your own hours as long as reconciliations and reports are completed on schedule every month.



Rate: Please submit your desired hourly rate with your application.



How To Apply (Screening Instructions)



To ensure you read this job description entirely and have the attention to detail required for bookkeeping, please start your cover letter by answering these three questions:



Briefly describe your experience using Zoho Books for service-based businesses or digital marketing agencies. Are you Zoho certified?



If we pay our virtual assistants on the 1st and 15th of the month, how would you prefer to receive and track their hours/invoices?

title: Controller
description:
Ikigai Cases is hiring a Controller!

Location: Remote / Work From Home

Reports to: CEO





About the Company

Ikigai Cases (
) is a fast-growing ecommerce brand manufacturing aerospace-grade aluminum pill cases. Founded in December 2021 by two brothers after their father’s neurological diagnosis led them to discovering the issues with plastic pill organizers, we’ve built a multi-million dollar business in just over four years with a team of 25 across the globe. 



Our mission is simple: make exceptional pill cases and provide exceptional customer service. We deliver on this by managing in-house fulfillment at our Washington, DC facility (including custom engraving) and maintaining obsessive attention to detail.





About the Role

We are hiring a Controller to take complete ownership of our financial operations - accounting, reporting, payroll, budgeting, cash flow, tax coordination, and financial systems. This is a critical senior role, and we’re looking for someone whose professional identity is built around three things: the integrity of the numbers, running the finance function end-to-end, and providing strategic financial insight to the CEO.



The ideal candidate has served as a Controller (or equivalent) for an e-commerce or DTC brand in the $10–30M revenue range. You understand the financial rhythms of e-commerce: Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow swings, sales tax across multiple states, and the speed at which decisions need to be made. If you’ve done this before at a similar-sized company, you already know what we need.



At $11.5M in revenue and targeting $30M by 2028, our financial complexity is outpacing our financial infrastructure. We need someone who builds systems, not just operates inside them. You’ll report directly to the CEO and work hand-in-hand with our external financial advisor. No layers of management between you and the decisions your work supports.









Core Responsibilities

Monthly Close & Financial Reporting: Close books by the 10th of every month. Produce reviewed P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements in Finaloop. Resolve misclassifications proactively. Maintain a clean chart of accounts. No CEO intervention required.



Budgeting & Financial Planning: Prepare and maintain monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets. Own budget vs. actuals: produce variance reports monthly alongside the P&L close with plain-language explanations. Update balance sheet items and expenses weekly inside the company’s financial models.



Cash Flow Management & Forecasting: Maintain the 13-week cash flow forecast weekly and proactively. Flag upcoming cash movements, exposure, and risks before they become surprises. This is one of the most critical tools the CEO uses for capital allocation.



Payroll Operations (Zero-Error Standard): Own bi-weekly payroll across ADP (US) and Deel (Philippines). Submit the morning of payroll day, every cycle. PTO, overtime, and deductions captured before submission. You catch discrepancies before they reach the CEO.



Tax Coordination & Compliance: Own the relationship with Numeral on multi-state sales tax filings. Maintain the estimated tax payment tracker. Coordinate with our external CPA on annual filings. Flag tax exposure and timing proactively.

Vendor Payments, Disbursements & Financial Systems: Execute and double-check all vendor payments (Venmo, PayPal, wire). Track owner distributions and related-party transactions. Manage Finaloop, Shopify revenue reconciliation, and Google Sheets financial modeling. Manage financial admin including insurance, vendor accounts, and benefits.



CEO Reporting & Ad Hoc Analysis: Weekly: 13WCF update, flagged variances, upcoming cash movements. Monthly: clean financial statements with brief narrative. As needed: ad hoc financial analysis without requiring a detailed spec.



Why You Should Take This Role

-You’ll work at a brand obsessed with its customers, with a loyal following. Read the reviews: 

-A company that’s scaled rapidly in 4 years and is aggressively investing in growth.

-You’ll work hand-in-hand with the founder, not through layers of management, with full autonomy to own your domain.

-The company was founded to solve a personal problem - Tavish’s father battled a neurological condition for a decade and the family discovered the issues with plastic pill organizers.

-You’ll own the entire financial function for a company on a trajectory from $11.5M to $30M - a career-defining role for the right person.





Required Experience & Skills

-5+ years in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance operations

-Prior Controller or senior finance role at a company doing $10M+ in annual revenue - you’ve owned the full financial function, not just pieces of it

-E-commerce or DTC company experience strongly preferred - Shopify revenue recognition, inventory accounting, seasonal cash flow, multi-state sales tax

-Experience closing books independently, on a monthly cadence, without supervision

-Demonstrated accuracy record - you should be able to speak to this specifically

-US GAAP familiarity (CPA not required, but you must understand the principles)

-Experience preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets

-Payroll experience across multiple platforms

-Advanced Google Sheets / Excel (SUMIFS, financial modeling, pivot tables)

-Strong proficiency with Finaloop, QuickBooks Online, or equivalent cloud accounting platform

-Strong written and verbal English; ability to explain financial insights to non-financial stakeholders





Nice-to-Have Experience

-Experience working remotely for a US-based company from the Philippines

-Exposure to sales tax compliance across multiple US states

-Experience using Notion (or similar task management software)

-EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) familiarity

-Prior experience coordinating with external CPAs and tax advisors





What We’re Really Looking For

-Technical skills get you in the door. These traits determine whether you succeed:

-Detail orientation as professional pride - you catch your own errors before they go out, and you change your process so they don’t recur.

-Proactive disclosure - you surface problems before being asked, even when it’s uncomfortable.

-Ownership without supervision - if it’s due, it’s done. No prompting required.

-Direct communication - you push back when something doesn’t look right.

-Reliability - when you say you’ll be available, you’re available. When you can’t be, you say so immediately.





Compensation Details & Schedule

-Compensation: TBD based on candidate experience. Target compensation will be requested during screening.

-Work Hours: 50 hours/week, Monday–Friday. Core overlap with US Eastern hours (9AM–5PM EST).

-Paid Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

-PTO: 1 week earned for every 6 months worked at the company

-Location: Remote / Work From Home





To Apply

Fill out the application form here:

title: A Player Customer Support Operator | French E Commerce | Growth to Team Leader
description:
We are looking for an A Player Customer Support Operator for a growing French e commerce brand.



This is not a basic VA role.



This is not a simple copy and paste ticket role.



We are looking for a serious customer support operator who can help us manage real customer situations, reduce unnecessary refunds, prevent disputes and chargebacks, and protect the customer experience.



Our store is in French. You do not need to be a native French speaker, but you must be able to prepare high quality French customer replies with strong judgment, careful review, and the right tools.



Internal communication will be in English, so strong English communication is required.



You will work inside Reamaze, our customer support helpdesk.



This role starts part time, but it is not a casual side task. We expect a minimum of around 3 hours per day. Some days may require more time depending on ticket volume. Customer support can be unpredictable, so we need someone who can actively monitor the inbox and respond in a timely way.



This role can grow quickly into full time for the right person.



The right person can also grow into a Customer Support Team Leader role.



What You Will Do



Manage customer support tickets inside Reamaze.



Read the full customer conversation before replying.



Check order information, tracking status, and previous communication before preparing a reply.



Classify customer cases correctly.



Follow our SOP, templates, refund ladder, replacement ladder, and escalation rules.



Prepare warm, professional, accurate customer replies in French.



Use AI tools responsibly when needed, without blindly copying replies.



Keep clear internal notes.



Use labels and ticket organization correctly.



Handle normal customer support cases according to the SOP.



Apply approved refund and replacement steps when the case clearly fits the SOP.



Escalate sensitive cases before taking action.



Never make unsafe promises about delivery, refunds, replacements, discounts, or compensation.



Report recurring customer issues, weak spots, and customer objections.



Suggest improvements to templates, workflows, and support processes when you see a better way.



What We Expect From an A Player



We are not looking for someone who only follows templates silently.



We want someone who can follow SOPs carefully during live customer support, but also speak up when they see a stronger way to improve the system.



If you have experience from another successful fashion store, e commerce brand, or high volume support environment, we want you to bring that experience to the table.



If a template, workflow, or process can be stronger, we expect you to explain why and suggest a better approach.



A true A player does not only do the work.



A true A player improves the system.



If you are reading this carefully, remember this sentence: Ik heb alles aandachtig gelezen.



Important Application Note



In the application form, we will ask you to explain your real experience in detail.



Do not submit random store links.



Do not only list tool names.



We want to understand what you actually did.



If you used an e commerce platform, explain your real workflow.



If you used a helpdesk tool, explain how you handled tickets, internal notes, follow ups, labels, macros, and escalations.



If you handled refunds, disputes, returns, replacements, tracking issues, or angry customers, explain your role and what you did.



Generic answers will not be considered.



A strong answer explains the workflow.



A weak answer only says something like: I know Shopify, PayPal, Gmail, Zendesk.



Training and Responsibility



In the beginning, your replies will be reviewed before sending.



You will prepare drafts, receive feedback, and improve quickly.



As you prove that you can follow the SOP, understand customer cases, use good judgment, and avoid mistakes, you will receive more responsibility and more autonomy.



You do not need approval for every normal step once you are trained and the case clearly fits the SOP.



You must ask for approval when a case is sensitive, outside the SOP, involves a higher than approved refund, a dispute, a chargeback, a legal threat, a review threat, a return address issue, or anything you are unsure about.



If you understand the importance of details, remember this sentence as well: Ik werk nauwkeurig en volg instructies.



Growth, Milestones and Performance



This is a performance based role.



Good performance can lead to more hours, full time work, higher responsibility, bonuses, milestones, and promotion to Team Leader.



Strong performance, accuracy, ownership, loyalty, and useful improvement suggestions will be rewarded.



Poor performance, careless work, repeated mistakes, missed instructions, slow responses, or lack of ownership will not be tolerated.



This role is for someone who wants to grow, improve, and be rewarded for high quality work.



Required Skills



Strong English communication.



Real customer support experience.



E commerce support experience.



Strong attention to detail.



Ability to explain your previous workflows clearly.



Ability to follow detailed SOPs.



Emotional intelligence.



Calm communication with upset customers.



Good problem solving ability.



Ability to work inside a helpdesk system.



Ability to use AI tools responsibly.



Ability to prepare professional French customer replies with support tools.



Reliable work ethic.



Willingness to learn, improve, and suggest better ways of working.



Useful Experience



Fashion e commerce support.



High volume support.



Helpdesk ticket workflows.



Refund, return, replacement, and dispute handling.



Delivery delay and tracking related support.



Payment related customer cases.



Customer retention.



Dispute and chargeback prevention.



AI assisted customer support writing.



Improving templates, SOPs, or support workflows.



Paid Trial Period



We will start with a paid trial period.



During this trial, we will test your communication, speed, accuracy, attention to detail, ability to follow instructions, customer support judgment, draft quality, SOP understanding, Reamaze discipline, and ability to receive feedback.



If the trial goes well, we can move into a long term collaboration.



How to Apply



Do not apply by only sending a message here.



To apply, you must complete the full application form below:







Applications that do not complete the form will not be reviewed.



After completing the form, send me a short message here on OnlineJobs.ph with this exact sentence:



I completed the full application form carefully.



In that same message, include the three Dutch sentences hidden inside this job description.



If you do not include the three Dutch sentences, your application will not be reviewed.



This is to make sure you read carefully, follow instructions, and take the application seriously.



The final sentence you must remember is: Ik neem klantenservice serieus.



Compensation and Availability



This is an hourly paid role.



The hourly rate will be discussed based on experience, skill level, and quality of your application.



This role starts with a minimum expectation of around 3 hours per day.



Some days may require more time.



The role can grow quickly into full time if the collaboration goes well.



Please only apply if you are genuinely open to growing into full time work if needed.



Final Note



We are looking for someone long term.



If you are warm, sharp, emotionally intelligent, reliable, careful with details, serious about customer support, comfortable with active inbox responsibility, and excited by the possibility of growing into a Team Leader role, we would love to hear from you.

Funds received

Liquidity available

Complete visibility of what goes in and out of the business





Clean and accurate financial statements





Weekly liquidity summaries you can trust

You own the books — not just the data entry.

Weekly deliverables required

In addition to your resume, you must attach a short video (minimum 1 minute) where you:

(Bonus points if your answers reference real examples/metrics.)



???? Application Evaluation Focus

We are looking for:

? Clarity of thought and structured answers

 ? Real e-commerce bookkeeping experience

???? Equal Opportunity

We focus on ability and output, not location, degree titles, or certifications.

title: Brand and Graphic Designer
description:
SKYR N BOWLS



Brand & Graphic Designer (Remote) — Build the Look of an Exciting New Miami Wellness Brand

We’re a brand-new health-food concept launching in Miami, and we’re looking for a talented graphic designer to create our entire visual identity from the ground up. This is a rare chance to put your fingerprints on a brand from day one — the logo, the colors, the menus, the packaging, the whole feel. If you love clean, modern, aspirational design and want a project you’ll be proud to show off, keep reading.



Who We Are

Skyr N Bowls is Miami’s first protein bowl built on authentic Icelandic skyr — nearly 40g of protein, no added sugar, real ingredients, beautifully made. Think of the gorgeous, Instagram-ready açai bowl, but reinvented around a genuinely healthy, high-protein base. Our signature bowls have names like Lúcuma, Pink Coconut, Caffao, and Açai Bliss.

We sit right at the intersection of fitness, wellness, and beautiful aesthetics that defines Miami’s active culture. The brand should feel calm, clean, and aspirational — a small daily luxury, not just food. There’s a lovely international travel story woven through it too: Iceland, Amsterdam, Barcelona, and Miami.



The Creative Vision

We already have a clear point of view, and now we need a designer to bring it fully to life. Here’s the feeling we’re going for:

• A soft, sky-blue color palette — fresh, cool, and unmistakably ours.

• Minimalist, modern styling with lots of light and breathing room.

• Aspirational and wellness-forward — it should feel like permission to enjoy something delicious without any guilt.

• Keywords to keep front and center: real food, balance, vitality, self-care, trust, and freshness.

You’ll have real creative ownership here. We want your ideas, your eye, and your craft — not just hands to execute. The right person gets to define how an entire brand looks and feels.



What You’ll Create

This is a launch project first, with ongoing design work to follow as we grow. To start, you’ll design:

• A complete logo suite and brand identity.

• Our color palette, typography, and a simple brand guidelines document.

• Menu cards and price boards.

• Packaging — cups, labels, branded stickers, and to-go items.

• In-store signage and display graphics.

• Loyalty cards and promotional pieces.

• A starter kit of social media templates and launch content for Instagram and TikTok.

Once the brand is established, we’d love to keep working with you on an ongoing basis for social content, new campaigns, and seasonal designs as the business expands from our pilot toward a flagship Miami café.



Who We’re Looking For

• A strong portfolio in branding and graphic design — ideally with food, beverage, wellness, or lifestyle work.

• A real sense of modern, minimalist aesthetics and clean typography.

• Skilled in industry-standard tools (Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Figma, or Canva Pro).

• Able to take a brand vision and run with it — thoughtful, self-directed, and detail-oriented.

• Good written English and clear, responsive communication for remote collaboration.

• Reliable, organized, and able to hit deadlines.



Why You’ll Love This Project

• Build a real brand from scratch — a standout, complete identity for your portfolio.

• Creative freedom and a direct line to the founders, with no layers of bureaucracy.

• Fully remote, flexible hours — work from wherever you are.

• A genuine chance for an ongoing, long-term working relationship as we grow.

• A fun, positive, healthy brand you’ll actually enjoy designing for.



How to Apply

Please send your portfolio (or a link to it) along with a short note about why this project excites you. If you have any food, beverage, or wellness branding in your portfolio, point us to it. We can’t wait to see your work and find the designer who’ll help shape the face of Skyr N Bowls.

Eating healthy is an act of self-love — come help us make it beautiful.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

- Execution Alignment: Prepare and align BDR teams on campaign objectives, ICPs, scripts, and key messaging prior to launch.

- BDR Training & Coaching: Develop BDR capabilities through ongoing coaching, call reviews, roleplays, and feedback sessions focused on messaging, objection handling, and sales conversations.

- Performance Reviews: Lead client reporting sessions, present campaign outcomes, share insights, and recommend next-step optimizations.

- Client Success: Serve as the primary contact for a portfolio of clients, managing onboarding, strategic planning, and ongoing communication.

- Campaign Strategy: Build Ideal Customer Profiles (ICP), messaging strategies, and outbound playbooks tailored to each client's goals.

- Scripting Ownership: Create, test, and improve cold calling scripts and outbound

- List Coordination: Partner with the List Building Team to ensure prospect lists remain accurate, relevant, and aligned with campaign objectives.

title: Freelance Apparel Graphic Designer
description:
We make premium-casual gear for people who live across all three worlds. Think vintage, outdoor, authentic — not corporate logo wear and not luxury fashion. Our aesthetic lives in the same neighborhood as

  Howler Bros, Duck Camp, and Roark: hand-drawn, retro, screen-print-driven graphics with real outdoor soul.



  The role



  We're looking for a graphic designer/illustrator to create shirt and headwear graphics across our three pillars — from hero back-prints to small left-chest emblems. You'll work from written creative briefs

  (we provide concept, composition, palette, and references) and turn them into print-ready artwork.



  What you'll do



  - Illustrate original apparel graphics (badges/emblems, illustrative scenes, wordmark lockups) from our briefs.

  - Design in a vintage screen-print style — hand-drawn linework, halftone shading, distressed textures, limited spot-color palettes.

  - Accurately render real-world subjects (aircraft, boats, game fish, birds, fishing tackle) — getting the details right matters to our audience.

  - Deliver color-separated, print-ready files suitable for screen printing and embroidery, plus versions for DTG and web.

  - Produce color/colorway variations and adapt designs across product types (tees, hoodies, hats).



  You should have



  - A strong portfolio of apparel / merch / screen-print graphics (please include examples).

  - Mastery of Adobe Illustrator (vector) and Photoshop; comfort with halftones, textures, and color separations.

  - A genuine feel for the vintage outdoor / Americana aesthetic.

  - The ability to keep artwork to a limited spot-color count (typically 3–5) for cost-effective screen printing.

  - Reliability with deadlines and clean, organized, well-labeled file delivery.



  Nice to have



  - Hand-lettering / custom type skills.

  - Familiarity with hunting, fishing, surf, or aviation culture (you'll be drawing it).

  - Experience prepping files for screen printers, embroiderers, and Shopify product pages.



  Deliverables (per design)



  - Layered, print-ready vector master (.ai / .eps / .svg).

  - Color-separated files ready for the printer.

  - Flattened transparent PNG for mockups.

  - At least one alternate colorway (e.g., a 1-color/tonal version for hats or dark shirts).



  How we work



  - We send a written brief per design (concept, composition, palette, references).

  - You share rough sketches/concepts for feedback before final art.

  - Clear rounds of revision, then final print-ready delivery.

title: [CEBU BASED] Amazon Account Manager (Customer Service & Admin)
description:
QUICK HIGHLIGHTS



- Role: Join a profitable, fast-growing e-commerce brand as the detail-obsessed operator behind our customer service, admin, and Amazon operations. Our AI systems do the heavy lifting; you keep them honest and handle what they can't.

- Stage: Profitable, 12-year-old e-commerce business selling across 4 Amazon marketplaces (US, UK, DE, IRL), with consistent 30% YoY growth.

- Team: A lean team of A-Players in our Cebu office. Your work directly impacts company performance.

- Location & Schedule: Full-time and 100% on-site at our Cebu office, 11:00am to 8:00pm, Monday to Friday. This is not a remote or hybrid role, and there are no exceptions. Please only apply if you're based in Cebu and happy working from an office every day.

- Compensation: $800 to $1,120/month depending on experience, plus benefits (13 paid leave days, all PH holidays, HMO, performance-based 13th month, paid weekly).

- Why now: We've automated a huge amount of our operations. What's left needs a sharp, reliable human: the judgment calls, the customer conversations, the daily checks that keep everything running clean.



A QUICK NOTE ON THE TITLE



We've called this an Amazon Account Manager role because that's the background we want you to have. In practice it's broader than a pure Amazon job. Day to day, this is a customer service and admin role first, with Amazon operations as a core part of it. We specifically want someone who has worked inside Amazon Seller Central, because that experience and instinct is genuinely valuable to us, even though you won't be living in Amazon all day. If you have that background and you also love clean admin and great customer service, this is for you.



ABOUT THE ROLE



The heart of this job is customer service and admin, done to a very high standard. You'll handle customer and partner conversations our automated systems can't (with good judgment and excellent written English), keep our inboxes and records clean, run daily checks on our automated systems and flag anything off, and support our Amazon operations: Seller Central housekeeping, case follow-through, account-health monitoring. You'll also be cross-trained to run customer service solo when our ops lead is on leave: real responsibility, real trust.



This is a junior role with real room to grow into Amazon and e-commerce operations. What matters is not years of experience; it's accuracy, follow-through, and catching the thing nobody else noticed.



YOU'D BE A FIT IF YOU...



- Have 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller Central (VA, account admin, or CS role). You know your way around; you don't need to be a specialist.

- Have real customer service experience: you write clear, warm, professional replies and know when a situation needs escalating.

- Are detail obsessed: you catch errors before anyone else sees them.

- Follow SOPs exactly, and notice when the SOP itself is broken.

- Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to work our systems.

- Write excellent English.



NOT A FIT IF...



- You're looking for remote, hybrid, or work-from-home arrangements. This role is on-site in Cebu, every day, no exceptions.

- You're primarily focused on PPC, creative, content, or brand strategy.

- You want to build automations and AI systems (we have that covered; this role operates them).

- You're looking for a senior catalog or account management position (this is a junior role).

- You need constant supervision, or dislike process, repetition, and detailed data tasks.

- You're agency-based or juggling multiple clients.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Customer Service: handle the conversations our systems can't, in our brand voice, with judgment; cross-trained for solo CS cover when our ops lead is on leave.

- Admin Excellence: inboxes, reports, dashboards, data hygiene the team can trust, zero unforced errors.

- Systems Monitoring: daily checks on our automated systems; anything off gets flagged within one working day.

- Amazon Support: Seller Central housekeeping, case resolution with persistence and follow-through, account-health monitoring.

- Accurate time records and clean categorization, every day (we run on trust plus good data).



Attention to detail is critical for this role. We're looking for someone who actually reads job descriptions carefully, so when the form asks what your favorite number is, the answer is 99.



WHY JOIN US



- Clarity, not guesswork: You'll always know what's expected and where you stand. Clear SOPs, clear targets, fast and direct feedback.

- Your work gets seen: We measure work closely. If you take pride in accuracy and follow-through, good work gets noticed and rewarded, not lost.

- Stability: A profitable, 12-year-old business that pays weekly, on time, every time.

- Learning: Work directly with experienced e-commerce operators and modern AI tools every day.

- Culture: Low-drama. High-clarity. Feedback-friendly. Do good work, get treated like an adult.



HOW TO APPLY



To apply, please complete this short application form: 



Apply through the form only. Applications sent any other way will not be reviewed.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We review your application form.

2. Initial conversation.

3. Deep dive into your Amazon and customer service experience.

4. Practical work-sample exercise (realistic scenarios from the actual role).

5. Final round interview on site in our Cebu office with leadership and culture fit.

If you're early in your career, this likely isn't the right fit. But if you're an experienced PPC and social specialist who wants long-term, stable work with a team that values quality, we'd love to hear from you.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Owning paid campaigns end to end across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and Meta — strategy, setup, optimisation, and reporting

- Taking a brief or business goal and turning it into a complete campaign plan and structure

- Researching keywords and audiences, writing ad copy, and building well-structured campaigns and ad groups

- Managing budgets and bids, and optimising for CPC, CPA, and ROAS based on real data

- Planning and managing social media content and calendars across platforms

- Creating clean, on-brand graphics and captions (Canva or similar)

- Setting up and using conversion tracking to measure what's working (GA4, UTMs, conversion goals)

- Reporting clearly on performance and proactively recommending improvements



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR (SENIOR ROLE)

- 3+ years of hands-on PPC experience across Google and/or Microsoft Ads, plus Meta

- Proven track record managing live budgets and improving campaign performance

- Strong grasp of campaign metrics and the ability to act on them independently

- Experience running and growing business social media accounts

- Confident, persuasive copywriting in fluent English

- Comfortable owning conversion tracking and reading the data (GA4, tag setup, UTMs)

- Self-directed — able to take a mandate and deliver without close supervision

- Organised, reliable, and clear in async remote communication

- A track record of results you can talk through (campaigns, spend managed, outcomes)



NICE TO HAVE

- Google Ads / Microsoft Ads certifications

- Experience advertising for local/service businesses and trades

- Landing-page and conversion-rate optimisation experience

- Experience using AI tools for content, ad copy, and campaign work

- Good design or short-form video skills



HOW WE WORK

- Fully remote, async-first (we use Teams)

- Clear goals, high standards, genuine room to grow as we scale

- Long-term, stable relationship for the right senior person



To apply, please share:

1. Examples of campaigns you've managed — platform, budget, and the results you achieved

2. A short note on how you'd approach a new client campaign from a standing start

3. One AI tool you use in your PPC or social workflow (we like Claude Design too!)



Applications that don't include real campaign results won't be considered.
